a: Ibbaya lehu: nesachim habbaim bifne atzman teunin shira o en teunin shira? kevan deamar shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: "minnayin sheen omrim shira ella al hayyayin" — amrinan, o dilma al achila ushetiyya amrinan, ashshetiyyay lechoda la amrinan?
Ta shema: rabbi yose omer: megalgelin zechut leyom zakkay vechulei.
Hay shira may avidtay? illema deolat chova, mi hava? beshiva asar betammuz batal hattamid! veella deolat nedava — veha tane rav mari bereh derav kahana dela tzericha! ella lav dinsachin.
Amar rava, veittema rav ashe: vetisbera?! shira deyomeh "laAdonai haaretz umeloah", "vayyashev alehem et onam" beshira dearbea beshabba hu! ella ilyay bealma hu dinfal lehu befummayyhu.
Veha "omdim al duchanan" katane! kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: omer shira shello al hakkorban. i hachi, binsachim name lema! nafek minneh chureba.
Gufa, rabbi yose omer: megalgelin zechut leyom zakkay vechulei.

Barishona, bemotzae sheviit mi mashkachat la? vehachtiv: "beesrim vechamesh shana legalutenu, berosh hashshana beasor lachodesh, bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair"! ezo hi shana sherosh hashshana beasor lachodesh? heve omer: ze yovel.
Vei salka datach bechad beshavua charuv, mechad beshavua lechad beshavua — tamne, lechad beshavua acharina — chamesh esre havvyayn.
Amar ravina: bearba esre shana achar shana shehukketa hair.
I hachi, "beesrim vechamesh shana"? esrim vashesh havyayn! deamar mar: galu besheva, galu bishmone.
Galu bishmone esre, galu bitsha esre.
Mishshav vead tamne sere — chad sere, vachamesh esre — esrim veshet havya!

Amar lach ravina: uledidach mi nicha? mikkede galu name bitsha esre, mishshav vead teshasre — tarte sere, vearba sere — esrim veshet havyayn! ella may it lach lememar? levar mishshatta diglo ba. ledidi name — levar mishshatta diglo ba.
Mikkol makom, teshasre leravina kashya!
Mi savrat shalosh galiyyot havay? galu besheva lechibbush yehoyakim, shehi shemone linvuchadnetztzar, galu bishmone esre lechibbush yehoyakim, shehi tesha esre linvuchadnetztzar.
Deamar mar: shana rishona kibbesh ninve,
b: Sheniyya ala vechibbesh yehoyakim.
Vechen bashsheniyya.
Usheniyya bemotzae sheviit mi mashkachat la? mikkedi bayit sheni kamma kam? arba mea veesrim. arba mea — temanya yovele, arbesre — tere shavua, pashu lehu shet, have leh beshitta bashshavua.
Ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: "shenat chamishshim ola lechan ulechan", ayyti temanya mittemanya yovele, vehane shet — have arbesar, ishtechach divmotzae sheviit charuv.

I rabbi yehuda, barishona la mashkachat la! detanya: shiva asar yovelot manu yisrael mishshennichnesu laaretz vead sheyyatzu, vei atta yachol lomar mishshaa shennichnesu manu, sheim atta omer ken — nimtza bayit charev bitchillat yovel, vei atta motze "bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair".
Ella tze mehem sheva shekkibbeshu, vesheva shechilleku, veatta motze "bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair".
Vei rabbi yehuda, ayyti shavsere mishshavsere yovele, shedi ahane — hava leh bitlata bashshavua!
Hanach shene deaglinhu sancheriv, ad daata yirmeya ahderinhu — la kachashev lehu.
Ibbaet ema: leolam rabbanan, vechi katane "vechen bashsheniyya" — ashsheara.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi, mishmarto shel yehoyariv bashsheniyya mi havay?

Vehatanya: arba mishmarot alu min haggola — yedaya vecharim pashchur veimmer, amdu neviim shebbenehem vechillekum leesrim vearba mishmarot, belalum unetanum bakkalpi, ba yedaya venatal chelko vechelek chaverav shesh,

a: Ba charim venatal chelko vechelek chaverav shesh, vechen pashchur vechen immer. hitkinu neviim shebbenehem sheafillu yehoyariv rosh mishmarot ole — lo yiddache yedaya mimmekomo, ella yedaya ikkar vihoyariv tafel lo, ella ashsheara.
Rav ashe amar: hanach shet shene ad desalek ezra umekaddesh la ka chashev lehu,
Dichtiv: "bedayin betelat avidat bet elaha di birushelem", uchetiv: "veshetzi bayta dena ad yom telata lirach adar dehi shenat shet lemalchut daryavesh malka".
Vetana: beoto zeman leshana habbaa ala ezra vegaluto immo, dichtiv: "vayyavo yerushalam bachodesh hachamishi hi hashshana hashsheviit lammelech".

Gufa: shiva asar yovelot manu yisrael mishshennichnesu laaretz vead sheyyatzu, vei atta yachol lomar mishshennichnesu manu, sheim atta omer mishshennichnesu manu, nimtza bayit charev bitchillat yovel, vei atta motze "bearba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair" vechulei.
Sheva shekkibbeshu menalan? dekaamar kalev: "ben arbaim shana [anochi] bishloach oti moshe eved Adonai mikkadesh barnea leraggel et haaretz, veatta anochi hayyom ben chamesh ushemonim".

Veamar mar: shana rishona asa moshe mishkan, sheniyya hukam hammishkan veshalach meraggelim, ki avur yarden kalev bar kamma have? bar temanan neche tarten, ki ka mefalleg nachalot kaamar: "ben chamesh ushemonim shana anochi", ishtechach desheva kibbeshu.
Vesheva shechilleku menalan? ibbaet ema: middesheva kibbeshu sheva chilleku, veibbaet ema: middela mashkachat lehu "arba esre shana achar asher hukketa hair".

Mishna en pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamevukkarin belishkat hattelaim, kede lashshabbat uleyamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, umosifin ad olam. en pochatin mishshete chatzotzrot, mittisha kinnorot, umosifin ad olam, vehatztziltzal levad.
Gemara temidin umusafin tuva havo!
Tanna bealma kae, veattemidin lechodeh kae, umay "kede lashshabbat uleyamim tovim" — simana bealma, vehachi kaamar: en pochatin mishshishsha telaim
b: Hamevukkarim belishkat hattelaim arbaa yamim kodem shechita, umanni — ben bag bag hi, detanya: ben bag bag omer, minnayin lattamid shettaun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita?

Talmud lomar: "tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado", ulehallan hu omer: "vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom lachodesh harishon", ma lehallan taun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita, af kan taun bikkur arbaa yamim kodem shechita.
Dayka name, dekatane "kede lashshabbat", vela katane "lashshabbat", shema minna.
Mishshete chatzotzrot umosifin vechulei. vead kamma? amar rav huna, veamri la amar rav zavdi amar rav huna: ad mea veesrim, shenneemar: "veimmahem kohanim lemea veesrim machtzerim bachatzotzrot".

Mittisha kinnorot vechulei vetziltzal levad. mena hane mille? amar rav assi, deamar kera: "veasaf bamtziltayim lehashemia". metziltayim tere havu! kevan dachada avidta avdi, vechad gavra aved behu — kare lehu chad.

Mishna en pochatin mishshenem asar leviyyim omdin al hadduchan, umosifin ad olam. en hakkatan nichnas laazara laavoda, ella beshaa shehalleviyyim omrim bashshir, velo hayu omrim benevel uvechinnor, ella bappe, kede litten tevel banneima.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: en olin lamminyan, veen olin ladduchan, ella baaretz hayu omdin, verashehen ben ragle haleviyyim, vetzoare haleviyyim hayu nikrain.
Gemara hane keneged mi? amar rav pappa: keneged tisha kinnorot [ushene] nevalim vetziltzal echad, shenneemar: "hu uvanav veechav shenem asar".

En hakkatan nichnas laazara laavoda ella beshaa shehalleviyyim kulei. mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "vayyaamod yeshua banav veechav kadmiel uvanav bene yehuda keechad lenatztzeach al ose hammelacha bevet haelohim vegomer".

Lo hayu omrim lo benevel velo bechinnor, ella bappe kulei. lememra denevel lechud vechinnor lechud? lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: kinnor shel mikdash shel shivat nimin haya, shenneemar: "sva semachot panecha", al tikre "sova" ella "sheva".
Veshel yemot hammashiach shemona, shenneemar: "limnatztzeach al hashsheminit", al nima sheminit.
Shel olam habba eser, shenneemar: "ale asor vaale navel ale higgayon bechinnor".
Veomer: "hodu laAdonai bechinnor benevel asor zammeru lo shiru lo shir chadash"!
Afillu tema rabbi yehuda, laolam habba, ayyeyde dinfishi nimin dideh, nefish kaleh ki nevel, kare leh "nevel".

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: en olin min hamminyan kulei. tana: vesoade haleviyyim hayu nikrain. vetanna didan? kevan dehanne katin kalayyhu, vehane av kalayyhu, hane mekatteti vehane la mekatteti, kare lehu "tzoare".
Hadaran alach en neerachin.
Mishna yesh baarachin lehakel ulehachmir, uvisde achuzza lehakel ulehachmir, uveshor hammuad shehemit haeved lehakel ulehachmir, baones uvamfatte uvammotzi shem ra lehakel ulehachmir.
Yesh baarachin lehakel ulehachmir, ketzad? echad sheheerich et hannae shebbeyisrael veet hakkaur shebbeyisrael, noten chamishshim sela, veim amar: "hare damav alay", noten et shovvyo.
Gemara yesh baarachin lehakel vechulei ulehachmir ketzad echad sheheerich kulei. beyisrael — in, baggoyim — la.
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi meir, ditnan: goy, rabbi meir omer: neerach, aval lo maarich?
Afillu tema rabbi meir, hu haddin daafillu goy name, ella

a: Milleta aggav orcheh kamashma lan, kidrav yehuda amar rav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: asur laadam sheyyomar "kamma nae goy ze".
Velitne "et hannae shebbeyisrael veet hakkaur shebbaggoyim"! bechad umma kamayyre, bitre umme la mayyre.
Vela? veha katane: haggedola shebbakkehunna veet hakketanna shebbeyisrael! hatam chad umma hu, ella mikdaysh hu dekaddishi kohanim tefe.
Veibbaet ema, ayyeyde deka bae lemitne sefa "sede achuzza", divyisrael hu demashkachat la, begoy la mashkachat la, delav bene achuzza ninhu, mishshum hachi katane la beyisrael.

Mishna bisde achuzza lehakel ulehachamir, ketzad? echad hammakdish becholat hammachoz, veechad hammakdish bappardesot sevaste, noten zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef, uvisde mikna noten et shovvyo.
Rabbi eliezer omer: echad sede mikna veechad sede achuzza, ma ben sede achuzza lisde mikna? shebbisde achuzza hu noten chomesh, uvisde mikna eno noten chomesh.

Gemara amar rav huna: hikdish sade melea ilanot, keshehu podan — pode ilanot beshovvyan, vechozer ufode karka bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef. alma kasavar rav huna: adam makdish — beayin yafa makdish.
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna: echad hammakdish becholat hammachoz, veechad hammakdish befardesot sevaste, noten bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef! amar leh: reuya lefardesot kaamena.
Etiveh: "bet zera" — en li ella bet zera, sede gefanim usede kanim usede ilanot minnayin?
Talmud lomar "sade" mikkol makom, amar leh: hacha name pode vechozer ufode.
Etiveh: hikdish shelosha ilanot mimmatta asara levet sea — hare ze hikdish et hakkarka veet hailanot shebbenehem, keshehu pode — pode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef.
Pachot mikken, o yater al ken, o shehikdishan beze achar ze — hare ze lo hikdish lo et hakkarka velo et hailanot shebbenehem.
Velo od, ella afillu hikdish ilanotav, veachar kach hikdish karka, keshehu pode — pode et hailanot beshovvyehen, vechozer ufode karka: bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef!
Vechi tema: hacha name pode vechozer ufode, ha middesefa pode vechozer ufode, mikkelal deresha la!
Ella, ha manni? rabbi shimon hi, deamar: makdish beayin raa makdish. detanya: hammakdish et hassade — hikdish et kullah. rabbi shimon omer: lo hikdish ella charuv hammurekav vesaddan hashshikma.

I rabbi shimon, ema sefa: velo od, ella afillu hikdish ilanotav veachar kach hikdish karka, keshehu pode — pode et hailanot beshovvyehen, vechozer ufode bet zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef.
Vei rabbi shimon — lezil batar pidyon, velifreku aggav arayyhu, deha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deazel batar pidyon!
Detanya: minnayin lelokeach sade meaviv vehikdishah, veachar kach met aviv, minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza? talmud lomar: "im et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato".
Sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yatzta zo sheruya lihyot sede achuzza, divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon.
Rabbi meir omer: minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv, umet aviv, veachar kach hikdishah, minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza?
b: Talmud lomar: "im et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" — sade sheenah sede achuzza, yatzta zo shehi sede achuzza.
Illu lerabbi yehuda ulerabbi shimon, afillu hikdishah veachar kach met av — sede achuzza havya. may tama? i mishshum kera — kera lechidrabbi meir hu daata!
Ella lav mishshum deazel batar pidyon?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon kera ashkachu uderush.
Im ken, lichtov rachamana: "im et sede miknato asher lo achuzzato", may "missede" — sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza.
Amar rav pappa: hikdish terashin — podan beshovvyan, may tama? "bet zera" amar rachamana, vehane lav bene zeria ninhu.
Lo gealan — yotzin [lakkohanim] bayyovel, may tama? "sade" amar rachamana, kol dehu.

Machar terashin — nigalin pachot mishte shanim, may tama? "mispar shene tevuot" amar rachamana, vehay lav bene tevua ninhu. lo gealan — (chozeret) [chozrin] labbealim bayyovel, may tama? "veshav laachuzzato" amar rachamana, vehay name achuzza hi.
Hikdish ilanot — (pode) [podan] beshovvyehen, may tama? "bet zera" amar rachamana, velo ilanot. lo gealan — en yotzin lakkohanim bayyovel, "vehaya hassade" amar rachamana, velo ilanot.

Machar ilanot — en nigalin pachot mishte shanim, may tama? "shene tevuot" amar rachamana, vehane bene tevuot ninhu. lo gealan — en chozeret labbealim beyovel, may tama? "veshav laachuzzato" amar rachamana, velo ilanot.
Amar mar: hikdish ilanot — (pode) [podan] beshovvyan. ammay? velikdeshu aggav arayyhu, velifrekuha aggav arayyhu!
Vechi tema: ilanot akdesh, ara la akdesh — vehaamri nehardae: man dimzabben leh dikla lechavreh, kane leh mishshippula vead tehoma! lav mi ittemar ala: beva mechamat taana!
Sede mikna noten shovvyo. tanu rabbanan: "bemichsat" — ma ba lilmod? lefi shenneemar: "zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef", yachol af sede mikna ken? talmud lomar: "michsat".
Rabbi eliezer omer: neemar kan "vechishshav", veneemar lehallan "vechishshav", ma lehallan davar katzuv, af kan davar katzuv.
Ibbaya lehu: rabbanan it lehu gezera shava, umappekin leh lechomesh, o dilma let lehu gezera shava, velet lehu lechomesh?

Amar rava: mistabbera let lehu gezera shava, middegalli rachamana chomesh gabbe sede achuzza vegabbe makdish beto, havu leh shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Uleman deamar melammedin, middegalli rachamana chomesh bemaaser, bivhema tehora, uvivhema temea — have leh tuva, veen melammedin.
Tanya kevavteh derava, vela mittameh. tanya: "bemichsat haerkecha" — hikkisho hakkatuv laarachin, ma arachin en mosif chomesh, af sede mikna en mosif chomesh.

Mishna beshor hammuad shehemit et haeved lehakel ulehachamir, ketzad? echad shehemit et hannae shebbaavadim veet hakkaur shebbaavadim — noten sheloshim sela. hemit ben chorin — noten shovvyo. chaval baze uvaze — noten nezek shalem.
Gemara bemuad — in, betam — la. lema matnitin dela kerabbi akiva, ditnan: rabbi akiva omer: af tam shechaval baadam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem.
Afillu tema rabbi akiva, hu haddin daafillu tam name, veayyeyde deka bae lemitne sefa "hemit eved" "hemit ben chorin", divmuad hu demashkachat la, betam la mashkachat la, mishshum hachi katane muad.

Mishna baones uvamfatte lehakel ulehachamir, ketzad? echad sheanas ufitta et gedola shebbakkehunna veet hakketanna shebbeyisrael — noten chamishshim selaim, vehabboshet vehappegam — hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh.
Gemara ammay? ema: "chamishshim selaim" amar rachamana mikkol mille!
Amar rav zeera: yomru, baal bat melachim chamishshim, baal bat hedyotot chamishshim?
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, gabbe eved name, yomru: eved nokev margalit — sheloshim, eved ose maase machat — sheloshim? ella amar rav zeera:

a: Illu bau aleha shenayim, echad shello kedarkah veechad kedarkah, yomru: baal peguma — chamishshim, baal shelema — chamishshim?
Amar leh abbaye: i hachi, gabbe eved name yomru: eved bari — sheloshim, eved mukke shechin — sheloshim!
Ella amar abbaye, amar kera "tachat asher innah", mikkelal deikka boshet ufegam.
Rava amar, deamar kera: "venatan haish hashshochev immah vegomer", hanaat shechiva chamishshim, mikkelal deikka milleta achariti, umay nihu? boshet ufegam.
Mishna bemotzi shem ra lehakel ulehachamir, ketzad? echad shehotzi shem ra al gedola shebbakkehunna veal ketanna shebbeyisrael — noten mea sela.
Nimtza haomer befiv chamur min haose maase, shekken matzinu shello nitchattem gezar din al avotenu bammidbar ella al lashon hara, shenneemar "vaynassu oti ze eser peamim vegomer".
Gemara mimmay? dilma mishshum deka garem la ketala, dichtiv: "veim emet haya haddavar vegomer vehotziu et hannaara vegomer"!
Amar rava, amar kera: "ki hotzi shem ra", al shem ra shehotzi.

Vechen matzinu shello nitchattem gezar din vechulei. mimmay dilma deakkatti la mela seatan, deamar rav hamenuna: en hakkadosh baruch hu nifra min haadam ad shettitmalle seato, shenneemar: "bimlot sifko yetzer lo".
Amar resh lakish, amar kera: "vaynassu oti ze eser peamim", al ze nitchattem gezar din.

Tanya, amar rabbi elazar ben parta: bo uree kamma gadol koach shel lashon hara, menalan? mimmeraggelim; uma hammotzi shem ra al etzim vaavanim kach, hammotzi shem ra al chavero al achat kamma vechamma!

Mimmay? dilma mishshum derabbi chanina bar pappa, deamar rabbi chanina bar pappa: davar gadol dibberu meraggelim beotah shaa, dichtiv: "ki chazak hu mimmenu", al tikre "ki chazak hu mimmenu" ella "mimmennu", kivyachol, baal habbayit en yachol lehotzi kelav mishsham.
Ella amar rabba amar resh lakish, amar kera: "vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa", al dibbat haaretz shehotziu.
Tanya: amar rabbi yehuda, eser nisyonot nissu avotenu lehakkadosh baruch hu: shenayim bayyam, ushenayim bammayim, shenayim bamman, shenayim basselav, achat baegel, veachat bemidbar paran.
Shenayim bayyam: achat bayyerida veachat baaliyyay. bayyerida — dichtiv "hamibbeli en kevarim bemitzrayim".

Baaliyyay — kidrav huna, deamar rav huna: yisrael shebbeoto haddor mikketanne amana hayu, kidrabba bar mari, deamar rabba bar mari: may dichtiv "vayyamru al yam beyam suf vayyoshiem lemaan shemo"? melammed shehayu yisrael mamrim beotah shaa, veomrim: keshem sheanu olim mitztzad ze kach mitzrayim olim mitztzad acher.

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lesar shel yam: pelot otam layyabbasha! amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum yesh eved shennoten lo rabbo mattana vechozer venotlah hemennu? amar lo: ani noten lecha echad umechetza shebbahem.
Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum yesh eved shettovea et rabbo? amar lo: nachal kishon yihye arev, miyyad pelatan layyabbasha, dichtiv: "vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met al vegomer"
Shenayim bammayim — bemara uvirfidim. bemara, dichtiv: "vayyavou marata velo yachlu lishtot", uchetiv: "vayyalen haam al moshe".
Birfidim — dichtiv: "vayyachanu birfidim veen mayim lishtot", uchetiv: "vayyarev haam im moshe".
Shenayim bamman — dichtiv:
b: "Al tetzeu" vayyetzu, "al totiru" vayyotiru.
Shenayim basselav [bislav] — rishon uvislav sheni. bislav rishon — "beshivtechem al sir habbasar".
Bislav sheni — "vehasafsuf asher bekirbo".
Baegel — kiditeh, bemidbar paran — kiditeh.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: may dichtiv "ma yitten lecha uma yosif lach lashon remiyya"? amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lallashon: kol evarav shel adam zekufim veatta mutal, kol evarav shel adam mibbachutz veatta mibbifnim, velo od ella shehikkafti lecha shete chomot, achat shel etzem veachat shel basar, "ma yitten lecha uma yosif lach lashon remiyya"?
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: kol hamesapper lashon hara keillu kafar baikkar, shenneemar: "asher amru lilshonenu nagbir sefatenu ittanu mi adon lanu".
Veamar rabbi yose ben zimra: kol hamesapper lashon hara, negaim baim alav, shenneemar: "meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit", uchetiv hatam: "latztzemitut", umetargeminan: lachalutin.
Utenan: en ben metzora musegar limtzora muchelat ella peria uferima.
Amar resh lakish: may dichtiv "zot tihye torat hammetzora"? zot tihye torato shel motzi shem ra.

Veamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash veen yitron levaal hallashon"? leatid lavo mitkabbetzot kol hachayyot uvaot etzel nachash, veomrot: ari dores veochel, zeev toref veochel, atta ma hanaa yesh lecha? omer lahem: vechi ma yitron levaal hallashon?
Veamar resh lakish: kol hamesapper lashon hara magdil avonot ad lashshamayim, shenneemar: "shattu vashshamayim pihem uleshonam tihalach baaretz".
Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: kol hamesapper lashon hara rauy lesoklo beeven, ketiv hacha "oto atzmit", uchetiv hatam "tzamtu vabbor chayyay vayyaddu even bi".

Veamar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: kol hamesapper lashon hara, omer hakkadosh baruch hu: en ani vehu yecholin ladur baolam, shenneemar: "meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit geva enayim urechav levav oto lo uchol", al tikre "oto lo uchol" ella "itto lo uchol", veikka dematne la al gasse haruach.

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: kol hamesapper lashon hara, omer hakkadosh baruch hu legehinnam: ani alav millemala veatta alav millematta nedunennu, shenneemar: "chitztze gibbor shenunim im gachale retamim", en chetz ella lashon, shenneemar: "chetz shachut leshonam mirma dibber".
Veen gibbor ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "Adonai kegibbor yetze", gachale retamim hayeynu gehinnam.

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: ma takkanato shel mesapperoy lashon hara? im talmid chacham hu — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "marpe lashon etz chayyim", veen lashon ella lashon hara, shenneemar: "chetz shachut leshonam", veen etz ella tora, shenneemar: "etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah", veim am haaretz hu yashpil dato, shenneemar: "veselef bah shever (ruach) [beruach]".

Rabbi acha berabbi chanina omer: sipper en lo takkana, shekkevar kerato david beruach hakkodesh, shenneemar: "yachret Adonai kol sifte chalakot lashon medabberet gedolot". ella ma takkanato shello yavo lide lashon hara? im talmid chacham hu yaasok battora, veim am haaretz hu yashpil dato, shenneemar: "veselef bah shever (ruach) [beruach]".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: kol hamesapper lashon hara magdil avonot keneged shalosh averot, avoda zara vegilluy arayot ushefichut damim. ketiv hacha "lashon medabberet gedolot", uchetiv baavoda zara "anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola".
Begilluy arayot ketiv: "veech eese haraa haggedola hazzot", bishfichut damim ketiv: "gadol avoni minneso".
"Gedolot" ema tarte! he minnayyhu mappeka?
Bemareva amri: lashon telitay katel telitay, horeg lamsappero, velamkabbelo, velaomrin alav.

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "mavet vechayyim beyad lashon", vechi yesh yad lallashon? lomar lach: ma yad memita — af lashon memita. i ma yad enah memita ella besamuch lah — af lashon enah memita ella besamuch lah? talmud lomar: "chetz shachut leshonam".
I ma chetz ad arbaim vachamishshim amma, af lashon ad arbaim vachamishshim amma? talmud lomar: "shattu vashshamayim pihem uleshonam tihalach baaretz".
Vechi meachar dichtiv "shattu bashshamayim pihem", "chetz shachut leshonam" lema li? ha kamashma lan, dekatel kechetz.
Vechi meachar dichtiv "chetz shachut leshonam", "mavet vechayyim beyad lashon" lema li? lechidrava, deamar rava: devae chayyim — belishshaneh, devae mita — belishshaneh.

Hechi dame lishshana bisha? rava amar: kegon deamar "ikka nura be felanya". amar leh abbaye: may ka aved? galloye milleta bealma hu! ella demappek belishshana bisha, deamar: "hecha mishtechach nura ella be felanya".

Amar rabba: kol milleta demitamra beappe mara, let ba mishshum lishshana bisha. amar leh: kol shekken chutzepa velishshana bisha! amar leh: ana kerabbi yose sevira li, deamar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo amarti davar vechazarti laachoray. amar

a: Rabba bar rav huna: kol milleta demitamra beappe telata, let bah mishshum lishshana bisha. may tama? chavrach chavra it leh, vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh.

Ki ata rav dimi amar: may dichtiv "mevarech reehu bekol gadol babboker hashekem kelala techashev lo"? kegon demikkela leushepiza vetarchu kammeh shappir, limchar nafek yatev beshuka veamar: rachamana nivarcheh liflanya dehachi terach kammay, veshamin inashe veazlin veansin leh.
Tane rav dimi achu derav safra: leolam al yesapper adam betovato shel chavero, shemmittoch tovato ba lide raato.

Ikka deamri: rav dimi achu derav safra chalash, al rav safra leshayyole beh. amar lehu: tete li dekayyemi kol daamur rabbanan. amar leh: ha mi mekayyeymat — leolam al yesapper adam betovato shel chavero shemmittoch tovato ba lide genuto? amar lehu: la shemia li, vei hava shemia li — kayyemta.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: al shiva devarim negaim bain — al lashon hara, veal shefichut damim, veal shevuat shav, veal gilluy arayot, veal gassut haruach, veal haggazel, veal tzarut haayin.
Al lashon hara — dichtiv: "meloshni vasseter reehu oto atzmit".
Al shefichut damim — dichtiv "veal yikkaret mibbet yoav zav umetzora vegomer".
Veal shevuat shav — dichtiv: "vayyomer naaman hoel kach kikkarayim", uchetiv: "vetzaraat naaman tidbak becha vegomer".
Veal gilluy arayot — dichtiv: "vaynagga Adonai et paro negaim vegomer".
Veal gassut haruach — dichtiv: "uvechezkato gava libbo ad lehashechit vayyimol baAdonai elohav", "vehatztzaraat zarcha bemitzcho".
Veal haggazel — dichtiv: "vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit". tana: hu kones mamon sheeno shello, yavo hakkohen vifazzer mamono.
Veal tzarut haayin — dichtiv: "uva asher lo habbayit", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: mi shemyuchad beto lo.

Ini? veha amar rabbi anani bar sason: lamma nismecha parashat bigde chehunna lefarashat korbanot? lomar lach: ma korbanot mechapperin — af bigde chehunna mechapperin. ketonet mechapperet al shefichut damim, dichtiv: "vayyitbelu et hakkuttonet baddam". michnasayim mechapperim al gilluy arayot, dichtiv: "vaase lahem michnese vad lechassot besar erva".

Mitznefet mechapperet al gasse haruach — kidrabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: yavo davar shebbaggova vichapper al maase gova. avnet (mechapperet) [mechapper] al hirhur hallev, ahecha deiteh, dichtiv: "vehaya al lev aharon".

Choshen mechapper al haddinin — dichtiv: "veasita choshen mishpat". efod mechapper al avoda zara, dichtiv: "en efod uterafim". meil mechapper al lashon hara, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavo davar shebbakkol vichapper al maase hakkol.
Tzitz mechapper al maase azze fanim — ketiv hacha: "vehaya al metzach aharon", uchetiv hatam: "umetzach ishsha zona haya lach".
La kashya, ha deahano maasav, ha dela ahano maasav. i ahano maasav — atu negaim aleh, i la ahano maasav — meil mechapper.

Vehaamar rabbi simon amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shene devarim lo matzinu lahem bakkorbanot kappara, bedavar acher matzinu lahem kappara, shefichut damim velashon hara. shefichut damim beegla arufa.

Velashon hara — biktoret, detanya rabbi chanina: lamadnu liktoret shemmechapperet, dichtiv: "vayyitten et hakketoret vaychapper al haam", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: al ma ketoret mechapperet — al lashon hara, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavo davar shebbachashay vichapper al maase chashay.
Kashya shefichut damim ashshefichut damim, kashya lashon hara allashon hara!
Shefichut damim ashshefichut damim la kashya: ha didia man katleh, ha dela yedia man katleh.
Didia man katleh bar ketala hu! bemezid vela atro beh.
Lashon hara allashon hara la kashya: ha betzina,
b: Ha befarhesya.

Bea minneh rabbi shemuel bar nadav merabbi chanina, veamri la rabbi shemuel bar nadav chatneh derabbi chanina merabbi chanina, veamri la merabbi yehoshua ben levi: ma nishtanna metzora sheamra tora "badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo"? hu hivdil ben ish leishto, ben ish lereehu, lefichach amra tora "badad yeshev vegomer".
Amar rabbi yehuda ben levi: ma nishtanna metzora sheamra tora yavi shete tzipporim letohorato? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: hu ose maase pattit, lefichach amra tora yavi korban pattit.
Tanu rabbanan: "lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha" — yachol lo yakkennu, lo yisterennu, velo yekallelennu? talmud lomar: "bilvavecha" — sina shebballev hakkatuv medabber.

Minnayin laroe bachavero davar megunne shechayyayv lehochicho? shenneemar: "hocheach tochiach". hochicho velo kibbel, minnayin sheyyachazor veyochichennu? talmud lomar: "tochiach", mikkol makom. yachol afillu mishtannim panav? talmud lomar: "lo tissa alav chet".

Tanya, amar rabbi tarfon: temehani ani im yesh baddor hazze shemmekabbel tochecha, afillu amar lo "tol kesam mibben enecha", omer lo "tol kora mibben enecha". amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: temehani im yesh bedor hazze sheyyodea lehochiach.

Veamar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: meid ani alay shamayim vaaretz sheharebe peamim laka akiva al yede, shehayiti kovel alav lifne rabban shimon beribbi, vechol shekken shehosafti bo ahava, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "al tochach letz pen yisnaekka hochach lechacham veyeehavekka".

Bea minneh rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon: tochecha lishmah vaanava shello lishmah, he minnayyhu adifa? amar leh: vela modet daanava lishmah adifa, deamar mar: anava gedola mikkullam? shello lishmah name adifa, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam betora uvemitzvot af al pi shello lishmah, shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah.

Hechi dame tochecha lishmah vaanava shello lishmah? ki ha derav huna vechiyyay bar rav havo yatvi kammeh dishmuel, amar leh chiyyay bar rav: chazi mar deka metzaar li. kabbel aleh detu la metzaar leh. batar denafek, amar leh: hachi vehachi ka aved. amar leh: ammay la amart leh beanpeh? amar leh: chas li delikkesif zareh derav al yeday!

Ad hechan tochecha? rav amar: ad hakkaa, ushemuel amar: ad kelala, verabbi yochanan amar: ad nezifa. ketannae: rabbi eliezer omer: ad hakkaa, rabbi yehoshua omer: ad kelala, ben azzay omer: ad nezifa.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, usheloshtan mikra echad darshu: "vayyichar af shaul bihonatan vayyomer lo ben naavat hammardut", uchetiv: "vayyatel shaul et hachanit alav lehakkoto".
Leman deamar ad hakkaa, dichtiv: "lehakkoto", uleman deamar ad kelala, dichtiv: "levoshtecha ulevoshet ervat immecha", uleman deamar ad nezifa, dichtiv: "vayyichar af shaul".
Uleman deamar nezifa, hachtiv hakkaa ukelala! shane hatam, deaggav chabbivuta yattira dahava beh lihonatan bedavid, mesar nafsheh tefe.
Ad hechan lo yeshanne adam baachsanya shello? rav amar: ad hakkaa, ushemuel amar: ad sheyyafshilu lo kelav laachorav.

Behakkaa dideh — kulle alma la peligi, behafeshalat kelav laachorav — kulle alma name la peligi, ki peligi — behakkaa didvethu, mar savar: kevan dildideh la metzaer leh may nafka leh minna, umar savar: ate leitterode.
Vechol kach lamma? deamar mar: achsenay pogem venifgam.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: minnayin shello yeshanne adam baachsanya shello min hattora? shenneemar: "el hammakom asher haya sham oholo battechilla".
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar, mehacha "vayyelech lemassaav". may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu achsenay deakray.

Amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin shello yeshanne adam meummanuto umeummanut avotav? shenneemar: "vayyishlach hammelech shelomo vayyikkach et chiram mitztzor, ben ishsha almana hu mimmatte naftali veaviv ish tzori choresh nechoshet".
Veamar mar: immeh mibbet dan, uchetiv: "veitto oholiav ben achisamach lematte dan".

Ad hechan tachlit yissurin? amar rabbi elazar: kol sheargu lo beged lilbosh veen mitkabbel alav. matkef la rava zeera, veittema rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: gedola mizzo amru, afillu nitkavvevnu limzog bechammin umazgu lo betzonen, betzonen umazgu lo bechammin, veat amrat kulle hay?
Mar bereh deravina amar: afillu nehpach lo chaluko. rava, veittema rav chisda, veittema rabbi yitzchak, veamri la bematnita tana: afillu hoshit yado lakkis littol shalosh vealu beyado shetayim.
Davvka shalosh vealu beyado shetayim, aval shetayim vealu beyado shalosh — la, delekka tircha lemishdeyayho.
Vechol kach lamma? detanya deve rabbi yishmael: kol sheavru alav arbaim yom belo yissurin kibbel olamo. bemareva amri:

a: Pureanut mizdammenet lo.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: ilmale ba hakkadosh baruch hu im avraham yitzchak veyaakov bedin, en yecholin laamod mippene tochecha, shenneemar: "veatta hityatztzevu veishshafta ittechem lifne Adonai et kol tzidkot Adonai asher asa ittechem veet avotechem".
"Ze dor dorshav mevakshe fanecha yaakov sela", peligi ba rabbi yehuda nesia verabbanan, chad amar: dor lefi parnas, vechad amar: parnas lefi doro.

Lemay hilcheta? illema limalleyuta, demar savar: i mealle dara mealle parnas, umar savar: i mealle parnas mealle dara — ha ikka tzidkiyya, dahava mealle vedareh la hava mealle, veha yehoyakim, dela hava mealle vedareh hava mealle!
Deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: may dichtiv "bereshit mamlechut yehoyakim melech yehuda"?

Bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehachazir et haolam letohu vavohu bishvil yehoyakim, kevan shennistakkel bedoro nityayshsheva dato. bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehachezir et haolam letohu vavohu mippene doro shel tzidkiyyahu, kevan shennistakkel betzidkiyyahu nityayshsheva dato.
Ella leinyan tukepa venichuta kaamrinan.
Hadaran alach yesh baarachin.
Mishna hesseg yad bannoder, vehashshanim banniddar, vehaarachin banneerach, vehaerech bizman haerech.
Hesseg yad bannoder, ketzad? ani sheheerich et heashir — noten erech ani, veashir sheheerich et heani — noten erech ashir.
Aval bakkorbanot eno ken, hare sheamar: "korbano shel metzora ze alay", haya metzora ani — mevi korban ani, ashir — mevi korban ashir.

Rabbi omer, omer ani: af baarachin ken, vechi mippene ma ani sheheerich et heashir noten erech ani, sheen heashir chayyayv kelum. aval ashir sheamar: "erki alay", veshama ani veamar: "ma sheamar ze alay" — noten erech ashir.
Gemara hesseg yad bammaarich hu! kedichtiv: "asher tassig yad hannoder yaarichennu hakkohen".
Hashshanim banniddar? banneerach hu! ayyeyde deamar "hesseg yad bannoder", amar name "hashshanim banniddar".
Hesseg yad bannoder, ketzad? ani sheheerich et heashir noten erech ani. may tama? deamar kera: "asher tassig yad hannoder" — benoder tela rachamana.
Aval bakkorbanot eno ken, hare sheamar: "korbano shel metzora ze alay", haya metzora ani mevi korban ani, veaf al gav demaddiro ashir? veim dal hu amar rachamana, velo dal hu.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: keshehaya maddiro ani, vedilma aleh dideh chas rachamana, ammaddiro la, dehachtiv: "hu".
Amar rav adda bar ahava: "veen yado masseget" lerabbot et hannoder.
Aval maddiro ashir, hachi name demayyte baashirut?
Im ken, may "aval bakkorbanot eno ken"?
b: Chada ammetzora ani umaddiro ani, vachada lemaote metzora ashir umaddiro ani.
Salka datach amena: hoil veitrabbo, itrabbo, ka mashma lan.
Lefi shemmatzinu baarachin, ani sheheerich et heashir noten erech ani, yachol af ze ken, talmud lomar "im dal hu".
Ulerabbi, deamar: "omer ani af baarachin ken" — alma amar: batar chiyyuva degavra azlinan, veha la tzericha kera lemaote hu, lemaote may?
Lemaote metzora ani umaddiro ashir, salka datach amena: hoil veamar rabbi: "batar chiyyuva degavra azlinan", ka mashma lan.
Mishna haya ani veheeshir, ashir veheeni — noten erech ashir. rabbi yehuda omer: ani veheeshir vechazar veheeni — noten erech ashir.
Aval bakkorbanot eno ken, afillu met aviv vehinniach lo ribbo, o sefinato bayyam uvaa lo beribboot — en lahekdesh bah kelum.
Gemara ani veheeshir — "asher tassig yad hannoder". ashir veheeni — "al pi asher tassig".
Rabbi yehuda omer: afillu ani veheeshir vechazar veheeni — noten erech ashir. may tama derabbi yehuda? amar kera: "veim mach hu meerkecha" — ad sheyyehe bemachuto mittechillato vead sofo.
Ella meatta, veim "dal hu", hachi name ad sheyyehe bedalluto mittechillato vead sofo!
Vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: metzora shehevi korbenotav ani veheeshir, ashir veheeni — hakkol holech achar chattat, divre rabbi shimon.
Rabbi yehuda omer: hakkol holech achar asham, vetanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: hakkol holech achar tzipporim!
Ha ittemar ala, amar rav yehuda amar rav: usheloshtan mikra echad darshu, "asher lo tassig yado betohorato". rabbi shimon savar: davar hamechapper, may nihu — chattat.
Verabbi yehuda savar: davar hammachshir, umay nihu — asham. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: haggorem lo tohora, umay nihu — tzipporim.
Veella "hu" lema li? lerabbi — kidit leh, ulerabbanan — kidit lehu.
Ella meatta, "vehu ed", ad sheyyehe kasher mittechillato vead sofo!

Vechi tema hachi name, veha tanya: haya yodea lo beedut ad shello naasa chatano, venaasa chatano, pikkeach venitcharesh, patuach venistamme, shafuy venishtatta — hare ze pasul. aval haya yodea lo edut ad shello naasa chatano, venaasa chatano,

a: Veachar kach meta bitto, pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach, patuach venistamme veachar kach nitpatteach, shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa — kasher. ze hakkelal: kol shettechillato vesofo bechashrut — kasher.
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "o raa... im lo yaggid", biriyyay vehaggada tela rachmana milleta, veha ikka. veella "vehu" lema li?
Lechidtanya: raa sia shel bene adam omdin, veedav benehen, veamar "mashbiani alechem im yodim attem li edut shettavou uteiduni", yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar "vehu ed", vahare lo yiched edav.
Yachol afillu amar "kol mi"? talmud lomar "vehu ed", vahare yiched edav.
Aval bakkorbanot eno ken vechulei. aviv met vehinniach lo ribbo — ashir hu! amar rabbi avahu, ema: manniach lo ribbo.
Peshita! keshehaya aviv goses. mahu detema: rov gossin lemita? ka mashma lan.
Sefinato bayyam uvaa lo beribboot, ashir hu! amar rav chisda: keshehayta muchekeret umusekeret beyad acherim. vehaikka sechirut? sechirut enah mishtallemet ella levassof.
Vetippok leh mishshum sefina! ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi, ditnan: rabbi eliezer omer, im haya ikkar — noten lo tzimdo, vechammar — noten lo chamoro.

Mishna hashshanim banniddar, ketzad? yeled sheheerich zaken — noten erech zaken, vezaken sheheerich et hayyeled — noten erech yeled. haarachin banneerach, ketzad? ish sheheerich haishsha — noten erech ishsha, veishsha sheheericha ish — notenet erech ish.
Vehaerech bizman haerech, ketzad? heericho pachut mibben chamesh, venaase yater al ben chamesh, pachut mibben esrim, venaasa yater al ben esrim — noten bizman haerech.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: atta hikkashyta damim laarachin, margalit lekallim, veliddon bichvodo.
Yachol nakkish arachin ledamim, sheyyitten kishat netina? talmud lomar: "keerkecha ken yakum", eno noten ella bizman haerech.

Mishna yom sheloshim kilmatta hemennu, shenat chamesh ushenat esrim kilmatta mehem, shenneemar: "veim mibben shishshim shana vamala", hare anu lemedim bechullan mishnat shishshim, ma shenat shishshim kilmatta hemenna, af shenat chamesh ushenat esrim kilmatta hemenna.
Hen? im asa shenat shishshim kilmatta mimmenna lehachemir, naase shenat chamesh ushenat esrim kilmatta mimmenna lehakel?

Talmud lomar "shana" "shana" ligzera shava, ma shana haamura bishnat shishshim kilmatta, af shana haamura mishnat chamesh ushenat esrim kilmatta mimmennu, ben lehakel uven lehachemir. rabbi eliezer omer: ed sheyyehu yeterot al hashshanim chodesh veyom echad.
Gemara mufene, dei la mufene — ikka lemifrach kidfarchinan. "shana" "shana" yattira ketivi.
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi, dei rabbi — haamar: "ad" "vead" bakkelal.
Detanya: "miyyom harishon vead yom hashshevii", yachol rishon velo rishon bakkelal, shevii velo shevii bakkelal,
b: Kainyan shenneemar "merosho vead raglav", rosho velo rosho bakkelal, raglav velo raglav bakkelal?
Talmud lomar: "ad yom haechad veesrim lachodesh baarev". rabbi omer: eno tzarich, "rishon" verishon" bakkelal, "shevii" ushevii" bakkelal!
Afillu tema rabbi, shakkole meshakkeli kerae. mikkede ketiv: "mibben chodesh vead ben chamesh shanim", tu "mibben chamesh vead ben esrim" lema li? hilkach ishtekilu lehu.
Amar mar: "rosho" — vela rosho bakkelal, "raglav" — velo raglav bakkelal. menalan? ibbaet ema: shane simanim degufo missimanim derosho. ibbaet ema: "lechol mare ene hakkohen".

Rabbi eliezer omer: ad sheyyehu yeterot al hashshanim chodesh veyom echad. tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: neemar kan "lemala", veneemar lehallan "chodesh vamala", ma lehallan mibben chodesh veyom echad, af kan mibben chodesh veyom echad.
Veema ki hatam, ma hatam chad yoma, af kan chad yoma? im ken, gezera shava may ahani!
Tanu rabbanan: shana haamura bekadashim, shana haamura bevatte are choma, shete shanim shebbisde achuzza, veshesh shanim shebbeeved ivri, vechen shebbabben veshebbabbat — kullan meet leet.
Shana haamura bekadashim, menalan? amar rav acha bar yaakov, amar kera: "keves ben shenato", shenato shello, velo shel minyan olam.
Shana haamura bevatte are choma — dichtiv: "ad tom shenat mimkaro", mimkaro shello, velo shana leminyan olam.
Shete shanim shebbisde achuzza, dichtiv: "bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach", peamim sheadam ochel shalosh tevuot bishte shanim.
Shesh shebbeeved ivri — dichtiv: "shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit", zimnin devishviit name yaavod.
Veshebbabben veshebbabbat kullan meet leet. lemay hilcheta? amar rav giddel amar rav: laarachin. rav yosef amar: lefirkin deyotze dofen".

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mi peligitu? amar leh: la, ana amari chada, vehu amar chada. hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach peligi, man deamar laarachin la amar leyotze dofen"? vehaamar rav: hilcheta bechulle pirka meet leet.
Veella leman deamar laarachin, may tama la amar leyotze dofen"? dumeya dehanach, ma hanach dichtiva, af hanach dichtiva.
Veiddach, i salka datach dichtiva, hay "shebbabben veshebbabbat" —

a: "Shebbezachar veshebbinkeva" mibbee leh.
Umay shena nekeva, dechi mizzakna kayyma attilleta, umay shena zachar dela kae attilleta? amar chizkiyya: amri inashe: sava beveta — pacha beveta, savta beveta — sima beveta.
Hadaran alach hesseg yad.
Mishna haomer: "meshakkeli alay" noten mishkalo, im kesef kasef, veim zahav zahav. maase beamma shel yarmatya sheamra: "mishkal bitti alay", vealta lirushalayim veshakla mishkalah zahav.

"Mishkal yede alay", rabbi yehuda omer: memalle chavit mayim, umachnisah ad marpeko, veshokel mibbesar chamor vaatzamot vegidim venoten letochah ad shettitmalle. amar rabbi yose: vechi heach efshar lechavven basar keneged basar vaatzamot keneged atzamot? ella shamin et hayyad kamma hi reuya lishkol.
Gemara may "im kesef kesef im zahav zahav"? amar rav yehuda: perash kesef — kesef, perash zahav — zahav. peshita! ha ka mashma lan: tama deferash, ha lo peresh — patar nafsheh bechol dehu.
Kirchava, deamar rachava: beatra detikle kofra — patar nafsheh afillu bakkofra. peshita! la tzericha, deikka ditkel veikka dechayel. mahu detema: kevan dechullehu la tikle — la, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav pappa: beatra detikle shamche, patar nafsheh afillu beshamche. peshita! la tzericha, devatar deshakli shadu tere telata. mahu detema: betil torat mishkal, ka mashma lan.
Maase beamma shel yarmatya vechulei. maase listor?!

Chassore mechassera vehachi katane, veim adam chashuv hu, af al gav dela paresh — lefi kevodo amrinan, umaase beamma shel yarmatya sheamra "mishkal bitti alay", vealta lirushalayim veshaklu venatna mishkalah zahav.
Amar rav yehuda: haomer "komati alay" noten sharvit sheeno nichpaf, "male komati alay" noten sharvit hannichpaf. metivi: "komati alay", "male komati alay" — noten sharvit sheeno nichpaf.
Hu deamar kerabbi akiva, dedayek lishshana yattira, ditnan: lo et habbor velo haddut, af al pi shekkatav omkah veruma, vetzarich likkach lo derech, divre rabbi akiva.

Vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich, umode rabbi akiva bizman sheamar lo "chutz meellu" sheen tzarich likkach lo derech. alma, kevan dela tzerich vekaamar — letappoye milleta kaate, hacha name, kevan dela tzerich vekaamar — letappoye milleta kaate.
Ibbaya lehu: "omde" mahu?
b: "Rochbo" mahu? "yeshivato" mahu? "ovyo" mahu? "hikkifu" mahu? teku.
Mishkal yadi alay vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "mishkal yede" umishkal ragle alay", rabbi yehuda omer: mevi chavit umemalle mayim, umachnis beyad ad haatztzil, uvaregel ad haarkubba.
Veshokel besar chamor gidim vaatzamot, venoten letochah ad shettitmalle, veaf al pi sheen reaya ledavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "asher besar chamorim besaram".

Amar lo rabbi yose: heach efshar lechavven basar keneged besar, gidim keneged gidim, atzamot keneged atzamot? amar lo rabbi yehuda: omdin. amar lo rabbi yose: ad sheomdin, yamoddu et hayyad. verabbi yehuda: kamma deefshar avdinan.
Bayyad ad haatztzil, ureminhu: kiddush yadayim veraglayim bemikdash ad happerek.
Deorayyta ad happerek, bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam, udeorayyta ad happerek? veha gabbe tefillin dichtiv "yadcha", vetanna deve menashshe: "yadcha" — zo kibborit!
Deorayyta — kibburit kulla, bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam, vekiddush yadayim veraglayim bammikdash — hilcheta gemiri la.
Baregel ad haarkubba, ureminhu: "regalim" — perat levaale kabbin!
Bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam, udeorayyta — perat levaale kabbin?
Veha gabbe chalitza, dichtiv: "raglo", vetana: chaltza min haarkubba ulematta — chalitzatah keshera!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "meal raglo". i hachi, lemala mehaarkubba name? "maal", velo maal demeal.

Amar rav pappa: shema minna, hay istevera ad ara nachet, dei salka datach mifsak pesek, hava leh istevera "meal", veshaka "meal" demeal". rav ashe amar: afillu tema mifsak pesek, kol devahade kara kechara dame.
Mishna "dame yede alay" — shamin oto kamma hu shava bayyad uvelo yad. ze chomer bannedarim mibbaarachin.
Gemara hechi shayyminan leh? amar rava: omdin oto omed shel nizzakin.
Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam gavra zila hu, hacha gavra sheviach hu.
Amar abbaye: omdin kamma adam rotze litten beeved haose melacha beyado achat laose bishte yadav. yado achat may nihu, veiddach pesika? hayeynu hach! ella, yado muchetevet lerabbo rishon.
Bae rava: amaduhu omed shel nizzakin, veamar "deme alay", mahu? mi amar: ha amaduhu chada zimna, o dilma shane umedana deve asra meumedana deve telata?
Im timtza lomar: shane umedana deve asara meumedana deve telata, amar: "deme alay" vaamaduhu, vechazar veamar: "deme alay", mahu? hacha vadday amaduhu be asara, o dilma shavach bene uvene?
Amar: "deme alay", velo amaduhu, vechazar veamar: "deme alay", mahu? hacha vadday

a: Bechad zimna amdinan leh, o dilma kevan divze achar ze nadar, tere zimne amdinan leh?

Veim timtza lomar: kevan divze achar ze nadar tere zimne amdinan leh, amar: "shene damay alay" bevat achat, mahu? hacha vadday bevat achat nadar, bevat achat amdinan leh, o dilma kevan dekaamar "shene", keze achar ze dame?
Im timtze lomar: kevan dekaamar "shene" keze achar ze dame, amaduhu meelav mahu? mi amrinan: ha amid meelav vekae, o dilma baenan kavvavna leumedana?
Peshot miha chada, ditnan: "deme alay" umet — lo yittenu yorshin, sheen damim lammetim.
Vei salka datach amaduhu meelav have umedana, ha amid vekae, mi ikka gavra dela shave arbea zuze?
Amaduhu meelav — nechet leumedana, "damay alay" — la nechet leumedana.
Mishna chomer baarachin mibbannedarim, ketzad? haomer: "erki alay" vamet — yittenu hayyorshim, "damay alay" vamet — lo yittenu hayyorshim, sheen damim lammetim.
"Erech yadi", veerech ragli alay" — la amar kelum. "erech roshi", veerech kevedi alay" — noten erech kullo. ze hakkelal: davar shehanneshama teluya bo — noten erech kullo.

"Chatzi erki alay" — noten chatzi erko, "erech chetzyi alay" — noten erech kullo, "chatzi damay alay" — noten chatzi damav, "deme chetzyi alay" — noten deme chullo. ze hakkelal: davar shehanneshama teluya bo — noten deme chullo.

Haomer: "erko shel peloni alay", met hannoder vehanniddar — yittenu hayyorshin. "damav shel peloni alay", umet hannoder — yittenu hayyorshin, met hanniddar — lo yittenu hayyorshin, sheen damim lammetim.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: chomer bannedarim mibbaarachin, shehannedarim chalin al behema chayya vaof, veen niddonim behesseg yad, ma sheen ken baarachin.
Chomer baarachin mibbannedarim, ketzad? amar: "erki alay" vamet — yittenu yorshin, "damay alay" vamet — lo yittenu yorshin, sheen damim lammetim.
Amar "erki alay" vamet — yittenu yorshin. shema minna milva al pe gove min hayyorshin? shane hacha, demilva ketuva battora hi.
Shema minna: milva hakketuva battora kichtuva bishtar damya? hacha bemay askinan — kesheamad baddin.
Dichvavta gabbe "damay alay" sheamad baddin, ammay lo yittenu yorshin "damay alay"? mechussar umedana. "erki alay" — lo mechussar velo chelum.
Erech yadi veragli alay vechulei. amar rav giddel amar rav: venoten dameha.
Veha "lo amar kelum" katane! lo amar kelum lerabbanan, venoten dameha lerabbi meir.
Ha amra chada zimna, deamar rav giddel amar rav: haomer "erech keli ze alay" noten damav!

Mahu detema: hatam hu deadam yodea sheen erech lichli, vegamar veamar leshem damim, aval hacha mita katae, desavar ki hechi deikka "erech roshi" veerech kevedi", ikka name "erech yadi" veerech ragli", aval deme la kaamar — ka mashma lan.
"Erech roshi" veerech kevedi" — noten erech kullo. may tama? "nefashot" kaamar rachamana.
Ze hakkelal: davar shehanneshama teluya bo vechulei. leetoye min haarkubba ulemala.
Chatzi erki alay noten kulei. tanu rabbanan: "chatzi erki alay" — noten chatzi erko. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: loke venoten erech shalem.
Loke?! ammay? amar rav pappa: loke beerech shalem, may tama? gezera "chatzi (erki) [erko]" attu "erech chetzyo", veerech chetzyo have davar shehanneshama teluya bo.
"Chatzi damay alay" — noten kulei. "deme chetzyi alay" — noten deme kullo, may tama?
"Neder beerkecha nefashot" ketiv.
Ze hakkelal: davar shehanneshama teluya bo, leetoye min haarkubba ulemala.

Tanu rabbanan: hammaarich chatzi erech keli, rabbi meir omer: noten damav, vachachamim omrim: lo amar kelum. rava chalash, ul legabbeh abbaye verabbanan, veyatvi vekaamri: bishlama rabbi meir kasavar en adam motzi devarav levattala, la shena kullo vela shena chetzyo.
Ella rabbanan may kasavri? i adam motzi devarav levattala — afillu kullo name, vei en adam motzi devarav levattala — afillu chetzyo name!
Amar lehu rava veabbaye: rabbanan dehacha kerabbi meir savri la, vesavri la kerabbi shimon. savri la kerabbi meir, deamar: "en adam motzi devarav levattala".
Vesavri la kerabbi shimon, deamar shello hitnaddev kederech hammitnaddevim; kulleh orcheh leitnaddove, palgeh lav orcheh leitnaddove.
Haomer "erko shel peloni alay", umet hannoder kulei. may nihu? sheamad baddin.
Hayeynu hach! sefa itzterich leh, damav shel peloni alav, umet hannoder — yittenu hayyorshim.
b: Mahu detema, kevan dela amaduhu la ishtabud nichse, ka mashma lan: kevan deamad baddin ishtabode ishtabud nichse, veumedana galloye milleta vealma hu.
Mishna "shor ze ola", uvayit ze korban", umet hashshor venafal habbayit — patur milleshallem. "shor ze alay ola", uvayit ze alay korban", met hashshor venafal habbayit — chayyayv leshallem.
Gemara amar rabbi chiyyay bar rav: lo shanu ella deamar "deme shor ze alay ola", aval amar "shor ze alay ola", kevan deamar "ze" vamet — eno chayyayv beachrayuto, "alay lahavio" kaamar.
Metivi: shor ze ola — hashshor hekdesh umoalin bo, met o nignav — eno chayyayv beachrayuto. "shor ze alay ola" — hashshor hekdesh umoalin bo, met o nignav — chayyayv beachrayuto.
Mi allima mimmatnitin, deokemna dekaamar "deme"? hacha name dekaamar "deme".
Veha middesefa dekaamar "deme", resha dela kaamar "deme"! dekatane sefa: deme shor ola — hashshor chullin veen moalin bo, met o nignav — eno chayyayv beachrayuto, avel chayyayv beachrayut damav!
Resha vesefa dekaamar "deme", resha deamar: "yikdaysh hashshor ledamav", vesefa dekaamar: "lichsheyyavou damav yikdeshu".
Veha en adam makdish davar shello ba laolam? amar rav yehuda amar rav: ha manni? rabbi meir hi, deamar: adam makdish davar shello ba laolam.
Ikka deamri, amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, veamri la rame bar chama lerav chisda: keman? kerabbi meir, deamar: adam makdish davar shello ba laolam? amar leh: veella keman?
Veikka dematne la aha, hammaskir bayit lachavero venitnaggea, af al pi shechalato kohen, omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha", netatzo — chayyayv lehaamid lo bayit.

a: Hikdisho haddar bo — maale sachar lahekdesh. hikdisho haddar bo? hechi matze makdesh le? "ish ki yakdish beto kodesh" amar rachamana, ma beto birshuto — af kol birshuto! hachi kaamar: hikdisho maskir — haddar bo maale sachar lahekdesh.
Hikdisho maskir, hechi dayayr beh? bimila kae! vetu maale sachar lahekdesh? kevan dimal beh, nafek leh sachar lechullin!
Deamar: "lichsheyyavo secharo yikdash", veha en adam makdish davar shello ba laolam!

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: ha manni? rabbi meir hi, deamar: adam makdish davar shello ba laolam. ikka deamri: amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, veamri la rav mari bar chama lerav chisda: keman? kerabbi meir, deamar: adam makdish davar shello ba laolam? amar leh: veella keman?!
Mishna chayyayve arachin — memashkenin otan, chayyayve chattaot vaashamot — en memashkenin otan, chayyayve olot ushelamim — memashkenin otan.
Af al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyitratztze, shenneemar: "lirtzono", kofin oto ad sheyyomar: "rotze ani". vechen atta omer begitte nashim, kofin oto ad sheyyomar: "rotze ani".
Gemara amar rav pappa: peamim shechayyayve chattaot memashkenin otan, chayyayve olot en memashkenin otan.

Chayyayve chattaot memashkenin otan bechattat nazir, dechevan deamar mar: "im gillach al echad mishsheloshtan yatza, veim nizrak alav echad min haddamim huttar hannazir lishtot yayin velitamme lemetim" — pasha ba vela mayyte.
Chayyayve olot — en memashkenin otan beolat yoledet.
May nihu deakdemay kera, vehaamar rava: lemikraah hikdimah hakkatuv!
Ella beolat metzora, detanya: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yehuda ben beroka omer: keshem shechattato vaashamo oychavto, kach olato oychavto.
Veaf al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyitratztze, tanu rabbanan: "yakriv oto" — melammed shekkofin oto, yachol beal korcho? talmud lomar: "lirtzono", ha ketzad? kofin oto ad sheyyomar "rotze ani".
Amar shemuel: ola tzericha daat, shenneemar: "lirtzono". may ka mashma lan? tenena: af al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyitratztze, shenneemar: "lirtzono"!
La tzericha, defaresh leh chavreh. mahu detema: ki baenan daat middideh, aval middechavreh la? ka mashma lan, zimnin dela nicha leh delikkappar bemidde dela dideh.
Metivi: "chattato vaashamo shel peloni alay"
b: Ledaat — yatza, shello ledaat — lo yatza.
"Olato ushelamav shel peloni alay", ben ledaat ben shello ledaat — yatza.
Amar lecha shemuel: ki tanya hahi bishat kappara, deiratztzi bishat haferasha, ki kaamena ana bishat haferasha.

Ufeliga deulla, deamar ulla: lo chilleku ben chattat leola, ella shechattat tzericha daat bishat haferasha, veola en tzericha daat bishat haferasha, aval bishat kappara — idde veidde ledaat — yatza, shello ledaat — lo yatza.
Metivi: chattato vaashamo olato ushelamav shel peloni alay, ledaat — yatza, shello ledaat — lo yatza!
Shemuel moke la bishat haferasha, ulla moke la bishat kappara. amar rav pappa: matneyayta ahadade la kashyayn, ha bishat kappara, ha bishat haferasha.
(Veamorae) [leamorae] name la kashya: shemuel moke kammayyta bishat kappara, batrayyta bishat haferasha, ulla moke ippecha. amorae vadday peligi. peshita!
Mahu detema: may "bishat haferasha" dekaamar shemuel? af bishat haferasha, veaf al gav dehach kammayyta teyuveteh, ka mashma lan.
Vechen begitte nashim kofin vechulei. amar rav sheshet: hay man demasar modaa aggitta — modaeh modaa. peshita?
La tzericha, deasseu veiratztzi, mahu detema: battole batteleh, ka mashma lan.
Deim ken, litne: ad sheyyitten! may ad sheyyomar? ad dimvattel leh lemodaeh.
Hadaran alach haomer mishkali.
Mishna shum hayyetomim — sheloshim yom, veshum hahekdesh — shishshim yom, umachrizin babboker uvaerev.

Gemara may shena babboker uvaerev? amar rav yehuda amar rav: bishat hotzaat poalim uvishat hachenasat poalim. bishat hotzaat poalim — deikka denicha lemizban, amar lehu lefoalim: ezilu sayyeyru la nihalay. bishat hachenasat poalim — deniddechar deamar lehu: nezil nishayyeylinhu.
Tanya name hachi: shum hayyetomim sheloshim yom, veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom, umachrizin babboker uvearev, bishat hotzaat poalim uvishat hachenasat poalim.
Omer: sede feloni besimaneha uvimtzareha, kach hi yafa, vechach hi shuma, kol harotze likkach yavo veyikkach, al menat litten leishsha bichtubbatah, ulevaal chov bechovo.
Lema li lememar "al menat litten leishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov chovo"? deikka denicha leh bevaal chov, demekel bezuze, veikka denicha leh beishsha, deshakla al yad al yad.

a: Tanu rabbanan: shum hayyetomim sheloshim yom, veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: shum hayyetomim shishshim yom, veshum hahekdesh tishim yom. vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze shishshim yom. amar rav chisda amar avimi: halacha shum hayyetomim shishshim yom.

Yatev rabbi chiyyay bar avin vekaamar leha shemata. amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerabbi chiyyay bar avin: shishshim kaamrat o sheloshim kaamrat? amar leh: shishshim. ditomim o dehekdesh? amar leh: ditomim.
Kerabbi meir o kerabbi yehuda? amar leh: kerabbi meir, veha rabbi meir sheloshim kaamar!
Amar leh: hachi amar rav chisda: meavimi kulefe tave belai ala deha shemata, ba lehacheriz retzufim — sheloshim.
Besheni uvachamishi, shishshim, veaf al gav dechi chashev lehu mar leyome hacheraza la havu ella temanesar yome, kevan demashcha milleta shami inashe.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: en nizkakin lenichse yetomim, ella im ken hayta ribbit ochelet bahen. verabbi yochanan omer: o lishtar sheyyesh bo ribbit, o lichtubbat ishsha mishshum mezone.
Verav assi may tama la amar lichtubbat ishsha? deha takkinu le rabbanan maase yadeha, veiddach? zimnin dela safka.

Tenan: shum hayyetomim sheloshim yom, veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom, umachrizin babboker uvaerev. bemay askinan? ilema bevaal chov goy, mi tzayet? ella peshita bevaal chov yisrael. i dekaachel ribbita, mi shavkinan leh? veella dela kaachel ribbita, vekatane: nizkakin!

Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, moke la bichtubbat ishsha, ella lerav assi kashya. amar lecha rav assi: ulerabbi yochanan mi nicha? mi shavkinan mezone devadday ka mafseda, venaktinan hacheraza dela yadinan i marvevchinan i la marvevchinan?
Ha la kashya, betovaat ketubbatah bevet din, kidrav yehuda amar shemuel, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hattovaat ketubbatah bevet din en lah mezonot.
I hachi, izdekoke la mizdakkinan la, ella kevan deizdakkinan la meikkara, mizdakkinan la levassof.
Mikkol makom, lerav assi kashya! leolam bevaal chov goy, shekkibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael.
I hachi, ribbit name la lishkol! shekkibbel alav lazo, velo kibbel alav lazo.

Ta shema: "en nifrain minnichse yetomim ella min hazzibburit". bemay askinan? ilema bevaal chov goy — mi tzaet? ella peshita bevaal chov yisrael. i achel ribbita — mi shavkinan leh? ella dela achel ribbita, vekatane: nizkakin!
Bishlama lerabbi yochanan, moke la bichtubbat ishsha, ella lerav assi kashya. amar lecha rav assi: ulerabbi yochanan mi nicha? i ketubba, may irya miyyatme? afillu minneh dideh name bezibburit!
Ha la kashya, rabbi meir hi, deamar: ketubbat ishsha bevenonit, umiyyatme bezibburit.
Mikkol makom, lerav assi kashya! leolam bevaal chov goy, shekkibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael. i hachi, ribbit name la nishkol! shekkibbel lezo, velo kibbel alav lazo.
Ta shema: al menat litten laishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov chovo. bishlama baal chov, ben mar uven mar — kidshannin.
Ella ketubbatah, bishlama lerabbi yochanan nicha, ella lerav assi kashya!
Hacha bemay askinan — keshechayyayv mode. hasheta deatet lehachi, kullehu name keshechayyayv mode.

Marimar agbe (ketubbatah) [ketubba] ligrusha minnichse deyatme. amar leh ravina leammemar: vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav assi: "en nizkakin lenichse yetomin ella im ken hayta ribbit ochelet bahen". rabbi yochanan omer: o lishtar sheyyesh bo ribbit, o lichtubbat ishsha mishshum mezone!
Vaafillu rabbi yochanan la kaamar ella bealmana, dekamafseda mezone, aval gerusha la!
Amar leh: ha anan derabbi yochanan mishshum chinna matninan la.
Amar rav nachman: meresha la hava mizdekikna lenichse yatme, kevan dishmana leha derav huna chavrin mishshemeh derav: "yatme deachli dela didhu lezlu batar shivkayyhu", mikkan veelach mizdekikna.
Meikkara may tama la amar rav pappa: periat baal chov mitzva, veyatme la bene mebad mitzva ninhu. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: emar tzerare atpeseh.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu beshechayyayv mode, i name shammetu umit beshamteh.
Shelachu mittam, deshammetu umit beshamteh, vehilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua.
b: Tenan: shum hayyetomim sheloshim yom, veshum hahekdesh shishshim yom, umachrizin babboker uvaerev. bemay askinan? ilema bevaal chov goy — mi tzaet? ella peshita bevaal chov yisrael.
Bishlama lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua, moke la beshechayyayv mode, ella lerav pappa — kashya!
Amar lecha rav pappa: i baet ema — ketubba mishshum chinna, vei baet ema — bevaal chov goy shekkibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael.
I kibbel alav, lintar lehu ad degadli! shekkibbel alav lazo, velo kibbel alav lazo.
Ta shema: al menat litten laishsha ketubbatah, ulevaal chov chovo. bemay askinan? ilema bevaal chov goy — mi tzayet? ella peshita bevaal chov yisrael.
Bishlama lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua, moke la beshechayyayv mode. ella lerav pappa, bishlama ketubba — mishshum chinna, ella baal chov kashya!
Leolam bevaal chov goy, uchegon shekkibbel alav ladun bedine yisrael. i kibbel alav, lintar lehu ad degadli! shekkibbel alav lazo, velo kibbel alav lazo.
Rava amar: mishshum shovar. amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: umi chayyshinan leshovar? vehatnan: hannifraat shello befanav — lo tippara ella bishvua.

Veamar rabbi acha sar habbira: maase ba lifne rabbi yitzchak nappacha leantochya, veamar: lo shanu ella ketubbat ishsha mishshum chinna, aval baal chov — la, verabba amar rav nachman: afillu baal chov name,
Vei chayyshat leshovar — hatam name nechush! amar leh: hatam, kidamrinan tama, shello yehe kol echad notel meotav shel chavero veholech veyoshev lo bimdinat hayyam.
Amar rava, hilcheta: en nizkakin lenichse yetomin, veim amar: "tenu" — nizkakin. "sade zo" umane zo" — nizkakin veen maamidin appotroppos, "sade" setam umane" setam — nizkakin umaamidin appotroppos.
Amri nehardae: bechullehu nizkakin umaamidin appotroppos, levad minnimtzet sade sheenah shello, deachzoke sahade beshakkare la machzekinan.

Amar rav ashe: hilkach izdekoke la mizdakkinan, deha amar rava: hilcheta en nizkakin, vei mizdakkinan mokminan appotroppos, deamri nehardae: bechullehu nizkakin umaamidin appotroppos, levad minnimtzet sade sheenah shello, deachzoke sahade beshakkare la machzekinan.

a: Mishna hammakdish nechasav vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha, rabbi eliezer omer: kesheyyegarshenna yiddor hanaa, rabbi yehoshua omer: eno tzarich. kayyotze bedavar amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: af hearev laishsha bichtubbatah vehaya balah megarshah yaddirenna hanaa, shemma yaase kinuneya al nechasim shel ze veyachzir et ishto.
Gemara bemay kamippalgi? rabbi eliezer savar: adam ose kinuneya al hahekdesh, verabbi yehoshua savar: en adam ose kinuneya al hahekdesh.
Veella ha deamar rav huna: shechiv mera shehikdish kol nechasav, veamar: "mane lifloni beyadi" — neeman, chazaka en ose kinuneya al hekdesh, lema ketannae amra lishmateh?
La, ad kan la peligi ella bevari, aval bishchiv mera — divre hakkol en adam ose kinuneya al hahekdesh. may tama? en adam chote velo lo.
Ikka deamri: bevari dechulle alma la peligi deen adam ose kinuneya al hekdesh, vehacha beneder shehuddar berabbim kamippalgi, mar savar: yesh lo hafara, umar savar: en lo hafara.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hafara, vehacha beneder shehuddar al daat rabbim kamippalgi.
Veella ha deamar ammemar: neder shehuddar barabbim yesh lo hafara, al daat rabbim en lo hafara — lema ketannae amra lishmateh? vetu, rabbi yehoshua omer: "eno tzarich"? "eno moil" mibbee leh!
Ella hacha bishela dehekdesh kamippalgi.

Vehatanya: hammakdish nechasav vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha, rabbi eliezer omer: keshehu megarshah yiddor hanaa, rabbi yehoshua omer: eno tzarich, veamar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: hen hen divre bet shammay, hen hen divre bet hillel.
Shebbet shammay omrim: hekdesh taut hekdesh, uvet hillel omrim: hekdesh taut eno hekdesh.

Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. moshe bar atzri arva dechalleteh hava, verav huna bereh tzureba merabbanan hava, udechika leh milleta. amar abbaye: lekka denasseveh etza lerav huna, deligaresh lidvethu vetitba ketubbeta meavu, velahdera mihadaroy.
Amar leh rava: vehaanan "yiddor hanaa" tenan! veabbaye — attu kol dimgaresh beve dina megaresh? lesof iggallay milleta dechohen hava. amar abbaye: batar anya azla anyuta.
Umi amar abbaye hachi? vehaamar abbaye: ezehu rasha arum? ze hammassi etza limkor binchasim, kerabban gamliel.
Bereh shane, vetzureba merabbanan shane.
Vetippok leh dearev dichtubba la mishtabad!
b: Kabbelan hava. hanicha leman deamar: kabbelan, af al gav delet leh nechasim lelove — mishtabad, ella leman deamar: it leh — mishtabad, let leh — la mishtabad, may ikka lememar?
Ibbaet ema: rav huna hava leh veishteduf, veibbaet ema: abba legabbeh bereh shabode meshabed nafsheh.

Deittemar: arev dichtubba — divre hakkol la mishtabad, kabbelan devaal chov — divre hakkol mishtabad, arev devaal chov vekabbelan dichtubba — peligi. ikka leman deamar: it leh nichse lelove — mishtabad, let leh — la mishtabad, veikka leman deamar: af al gav delet leh — mishtabad.
Vehilcheta bechullehu, af al gav delet leh name mishtabad, levar mearev dichtubba, deaf al gav deit leh la mishtabad. may tama? mitzva kaaved, vela midde chassereh.

Hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh, veka (gershah) [megarsha] lidvethu. shalcha rav yosef bereh derava lekammeh derav pappa: arev tenan, hekdesh tenan, lokeach mahu? amar leh: tanna ki rochla nichashshev venezil?
Nehardae amri: ditnan tenan, dela tenan la tenan. amar rav mesharsheya: may tama dinhardae? bishlama hekdesh — mishshum revach dehekdesh, arev name — mitzva hu daavad, velav midde chassereh.
Ella lokeach, mikkede midda yada dechol chad vechad ikka aleh ketubba, ammay nezil venizbon? ihu hu deafsed annafsheh!

Mishna hammakdish nechasav, vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov — en haishsha yechola ligbot ketubbatah min hahekdesh, velo baal chov et chovo, ella happode pode al menat litten leishsha bichtubbatah ulevaal chov et chovo. hikdish tishim mane vehaya chovo mea mane — mosif od dinar, ufode et hannechasim haellu al menat litten laishsha ketubbatah ulevaal chov et chovo.
Gemara lema li lememar "happode pode"? mishshum derabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu: shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidyon.
Matnitin dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel, detanya: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: im haya chovo keneged hekdesho — pode,
Veim lav — eno pode. verabbanan, ad kamma? amar rav huna bar yehuda amar rav sheshet: ad palga.
Mishna af al pi sheamru chayyayve arachin memashkenin (oto) [otan], notnin lo mezon sheloshim yom, uchesut shenem asar chodesh, mitta mutztzaat, vesandalav, utefillav — lo, aval lo leishto ulevanav.
Im haya umman — noten lo shene kele ummanut mikkol min umin, charash — notnin lo shene maatzadin ushene megerot. rabbi eliezer omer: im haya ikkar — noten lo tzimdo, chammar — noten lo chamoro.

Haya lo min echad merubbe umin echad muat — en omer limkor et hamerubbe velikkach min hammuat, ella notnin lo shene minin min hamerubbe vechol sheyyesh lo min hammuat. hammakdish nechasav — maalin lo tefillav.
Gemara may tama? deamar kera:

a: "Veim mach hu meerkecha" — hachayehu meerkecha.
Aval lo leishto uvanav vechulei. may tama? "hu meerkecha", velo ishto uvanav meerkecha.
Rabbi eliezer omer: im haya ikkar, noten lo tzimdo. verabbanan? hanhu lav kele ummanut ninhu, ella nechasim ninhu.
Haya lo min echad. peshita! ki hechi desaggi leh ad hasheta, hasheta name saggi leh.
Mahu detema: ad haiddana dahava leh leoshole hava moshli leh, hasheta delekka demoshel leh — la, ka mashma lan.

Hammakdish et nechasav maalin lo tefillin. hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh, ata lekammeh derav yemar, amar lehu: salliku leh tefillin. may ka mashma lan? matnitin hi! "hammakdish nechasav maalin lo tefillav".
Mahu detema, hatam hu desavar mitzva ka avedna, aval leinyan zabbone — mitzva degufeh la (zavin) [mezabben] inish, ka mashma lan.
Mishna echad hammakdish nechasav, veechad hammaarich atzmo, en lo bichsut ishto, velo bichsut banav, velo betzeva shetztzava lishman, velo besandalim chadashim shellekachan lishman.

Af al pi sheamru: avadim nimkarin bichsutan leshevach, sheim tillakach lo kesut bishloshim dinar meshubbach mane, vechen para im mamtinin otah laitles meshubbachat hi, vechen margalit im maalin otah lakkerach meshubbachat hi — en lahekdesh ella mekomo usheato.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "venatan et haerkecha bayyom hahu" — shello yeshahe margalit lekallim, "kodesh laAdonai" — setam hahekdeshot levedek habbayit.
Hadaran alach shum hayyetomim.
Mishna en makdishin lifne hayyovel pachot mishte shanim, velo goalin achar hayyovel pachot mishshana achat. en mechashshevin chodashim lahekdesh, aval hekdesh mechashshev chodashim.
Gemara ureminhu: makdishin ben lifne hayyovel ben leachar hayyovel, uvishnat hayyovel atzmah lo yakdish, veim hikdish enah kedosha!

Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: en makdishin liggael begerua pachot mishte shanim, vechevan deen makdishin liggael begerua pachot mishte shanim — yehe adam chas al nechasav veal yakdish pachot mishte shanim.
Ittemar: hammakdish sadehu bishnat hayyovel atzmah, rav amar: kedosha, venoten chamishshim, ushemuel amar: enah kedosha kol ikkar.
Matkef la rav yosef: bishlama leinyan mechira, diflig shemuel aleh derav, ikka lememar kal vachomer — uma mechura kevar yotza achshav, sheenah mechura eno din shello timmacher?
Ella hacha, mi ikka lememar kal vachomer? veha tenan: higgia yovel velo nigala — kohanim nichnasin letochah venotnin dameha, divre rabbi yehuda.
Shemuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh, deamar: "nichnasin velo notnin".
b: Verav savar: sof sof labbealim mi kahadra? lechohanim hu denafka, vechohanim mishshulechan gavoah ka zachu!
May tama derav? deamar kera "veim mishshenat hayyovel", ushenat hayyovel bakkelal.
Ushemuel, mi ketiv "veim bishnat hayyovel"? "mishshenat hayyovel" ketiv — mishshana sheachar hayyovel.
Bishlama lerav, hayeynu dichtiv: "im mishshenat hayyovel" "veim achar hayyovel", ella lishmuel, may "achar hayyovel"? achar achar.
Metivi: makdishin ben lifne hayyovel ben leachar hayyovel, uvishnat hayyovel atzmah lo yakdish, veim hikdish — enah kedosha! amar lecha rav: enah kedosha begerua, aval kedosha venotnin chamishshim.
Mikkelal delifne hayyovel kedosha liggael begerua, veha rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: en makdishin liggael begerua pachot mishte shanim!
Amar lecha rav: ha manni? rabbanan hi, vaana deamri kerabbi, deamar: "rishon" verishon bakkelal, "shevii" ushevii bakkelal; hacha name "bishnat" ushenat hayyovel bakkelal.
I kerabbi, punedyon may avidteh?

Vechi tema let leh, vehatnan: hikdish shetayim veshalosh shanim lifne hayyovel, rabbi omer: omer ani noten sela ufunedyon, rabbi kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, deamar: "shenat chamishshim ola lechan ulechan".
Lishmuel, lema rabbi kerabbanan sevira leh, dei kerabbi yehuda — sela ushete funedyonot mibbee leh! al korchach lishmuel, rabbi kerabbanan sevira leh.
Ta shema: "velo goalin achar hayyovel pachot mishshana". bishlama lishmuel — "lo goalin leachar yovel pachot mishshana", ella lerav — may "achar yovel shana"?
Mi savrat achar yovel mammash? may "achar yovel"?

a: Beemtza yovel, dechol kamma dela malya leh shana la megara leh.

May ka mashma lan, deen mechashshevin chodashim im hahekdesh? ha behedya katane: "en mechashshevin chodashim im hahekdesh!" ma taam kaamar: ma taam lo goalin leachar yovel pachot mishshana — mishshum deen mechashshevin chodashim im hahekdesh.

En mechashshevin chodashim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheen mechashshevin chodashim im hahekdesh? talmud lomar: "vechishshav lo hakkohen et hakkesef al pi hashshanim hannotarot" — shanim atta mechashshev, vei atta mechashshev chodashim.
Minnayin sheim atta rotze laasot chodashim lashshana ose? hechi dame — kegon deakdesheh befalga dearbein vetamne.
Talmud lomar: "vechishshav lo hakkohen", mikkol makom.

Mishna hammakdish sadehu bishat hayyovel, noten bezera chomer seorim "chamishshim shekel kasef". hayu sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim, o selaim gevohim asara tefachim — enan nimdadin immah, pachot mikkan — nimdadin immah.

Hikdishah shetayim veshalosh shanim lifne hayyovel — noten sela ufunedyon leshana, veim amar: "hareni noten devar shana beshana" — en shomin lo, ella noten et kullo keechad. echad bealim veechad kol haadam, ma ben bealim lechol adam? ella shebbealim notnin chomesh, vechol adam en notnin chomesh.
Gemara tana: kor zera, velo kor tevua, mappolet yad, velo mappolet shevavrim. tane levi: lo meubbe vela medek, ella benoni.
Hayu sham nekaim amukkim kulei. velikdeshu beanpe nafshayyhu!

Vechi tema, kevan dela havu bet kor, la (havo) kadshi, vehatanya: sede, ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "zera chomer seorim bachamishshim shekel kasef", en li ella shehikdish kainyan hazze, minnayin lerabbot letech vachatzi letech, sea vetarkav vachatzi tarkav? talmud lomar "sade", mikkol makom!
Amar mar ukeva bar chama: hacha binkaim meleim mayim, delav bene zeria ninhu. dayka name, dekatane dumeya dislaim, shema minna.
I hachi, pachot mikkan name! hanhu negane deara mikkeru, shidre deara mikkeru.
Hikdishah shetayim veshalosh vechulei. tanu rabbanan:
"Venigra meerkecha", af min hahekdesh, sheim achalah hekdesh shana o shetayim, i name lo achalah, ella shehayta lefanav — noten sela ufunedyon leshana.

Veim amar "hareni noten" kulei. tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim amru bealim "harenu notnin devar shana beshana", sheen shomin lahem? talmud lomar: "vechishshav lo hakkohen et hakkesef", ad sheyyehe kesef kullo keechad. echad bealim veechad kol adam, ma ben bealim lechol adam? shehabbealim notnin chomesh, vechol adam en notnin chomesh.
Mishna hikdishah ugealah — enah yotza miyyado bayyovel, gealah beno — yotza leaviv beyovel, gealah acher o echad mehakkerovim, ugealah miyyado — yotza lakkohanim bayyovel.

Gealah echad min hakkohanim, vahare hi tachat yado, lo yomar: hoil vehi yotza lakkohanim bayyovel vahare hi tachat yede — hare hi shelli, ella yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket lechol echav hakkohanim.
b: Gemara tanu rabbanan:
"Im lo yigal et hassade" — bealim, "veim machar et hassade" — gizbar.
"Leish acher" — leacher, velo labben. atta omer: leacher velo labben, o eno ella leacher velo laach? keshehu omer "ish" — hare ach amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "acher" — velo labben.
Uma raita lerabbot et habben ulehotzi et haach? merabbe ani habben, shekken kam tachat aviv liida uleeved ivri.
Adderabba, merabbe ani et haach, shekken kam tachat achiv leyibbum. kelum yesh yibbum ella bimkom sheen ben? ha yesh ben — en yibbum.
Vetippok leh, dehacha tarte, vehacha chada!
Mishshum deeved ivri mehay pircha name hu denafka leh: kelum yesh yibbum ella bimkom sheen ben?
Bae rabba bar avu: bat mahu shettaamid sade leaviha? kevan dilinyan yibbum, ben uvat ki hadade patri — mokma, o dilma kevan dilinyan nachala, bat bimkom ben ki acher damya — la mokma.
Ta shema, detana deve rabbi yishmael: kol shehu acher bimkom ben, veha name bimkom ben ki acher damya.
Bae rabbi zera: ishsha mi maamid lah sade? baal mokem la, shekken yorshah, o dilma ben mokem la, shekken notel barauy kevammuchezak? teku.
Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: hikdishah pachot mishte shanim lifne hayyovel, mahu shettetze lakkohanim?
Amar leh: may dataych? "venigra meerkecha... vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel" — devat geraon — in, delav bat geraon — la.
Adderabba, "im lo yigal hassade... vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel", vehay name bat geulla hi.
Gealah echad min hakkohanim kulei. tanu rabbanan: "lakkohen tihye achuzzato", ma talmud lomar?

Minnayin lesade sheyyotza lakkohanim bayyovel, ugealah echad min hakkohanim, minnayin shello yomar: "hoil veyotza lakkohen, hare tachat yadi, utehe shelli?" vedin hu: beshel acherim ani zoche, beshel atzmi lo kol shekken?
Talmud lomar: "achuzzato", achuzza shello, veen ze shello. ha ketzad? yotza mittachat yado umitchalleket leechav hakkohanim.
Mishna higgia yovel velo nigala, hakkohanim nichnasin letochah venotnin et dameha, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: nichnasin velo notnin.

Rabbi eliezer omer: lo nichnasin velo notnin, ella nikret "sede retushin" ad hayyovel hashsheni. higgia hayyovel hashsheni velo nigala, nikret "retushe retushin" ad hayyovel hashshelishi. leolam en hakkohanim nichnasin letochah ad sheyyigalenna acher.
Gemara may tama derabbi yehuda? gamar "kodesh" "kodesh" mimmakdish bayit,
Ma lehallan bedamim — af kan bedamim.
Verabbi shimon, gamar "kodesh" "kodesh" mikkivse atzeret, ma lehallan bechinnam, af kan bechinnam.
Verabbi [yehuda] name nelayf mikkivse atzeret! danin kodshe bedek habbayit

a: Mikkodshe bedek habbayit, veen danin kodshe bedek habbayit mikkodshe mizbeach.
Verabbi shimon name, nelaf mimmakdish bayit! danin davar shemmattana lakkohanim, middavar shemmattana lakkohanim, veen danin davar shemmattana lakkohanim, middavar sheeno mattana lakkohanim.
Rabbi eliezer omer: lo nichnasin, velo notnin.
Amar rabba: may tama derabbi eliezer? amar kera: "veim lo yigal et hassade lo yiggael od, veim machar et hassade vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel".

Amar abbaye: sakkina charifa mafseka kerae? ella amar abbaye: tama derabbi eliezer kidtanya: "lo yiggael" — yachol lo tehe nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna? talmud lomar "od" — lichmot shehayta enah nigelet, aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna.
Emat? illema beyovel rishon — ammay enah nigelet? sede achuzza name havya! ella peshita beyovel sheni.
Uleman? ilema lerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon, lechohanim nafka! ella lav rabbi eliezer, ushema minna tama derabbi eliezer mehacha.
Vetisbera, rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hay "od" may darshi beh? ella, hacha bemay askinan — besade sheyyatza lakkohanim, vehikdishah kohen, veatu bealim lemifreka.
Salka datach amena: la tifrok, shettehe lefanav kisde mikna — talmud lomar: "od", lichmot shehayta enah nigelet, aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna.
Vehatanya: "bishnat hayyovel yashuv hassade laasher kanahu meitto", yachol yachzor laggizbar shellekacho mimmennu? talmud lomar: "laasher lo achuzzat haaretz".

Yeamer: "laasher lo achuzzat haaretz", ma talmud lomar "laasher kanahu meitto"? sade sheyyatzat lakkohanim, umecharah kohen, vehikdishah lokeach, ugealah acher — yachol tachzor labbealim harishonim? talmud lomar: "laasher kanahu".
Veitzterich "lo yiggael", veitztericha lemichtav "laasher kanahu".
Dei ketav rachamana "lo yiggael", dela ka hadra kelal, aval hacha deka hadra, tihdar lemara kamma, ketav rachamana "laasher kanahu".
Vei ketav rachamana "laasher kanahu", dela ka yahavi bealim dame, aval hacha, deka yahavi deme, tekum bidayyhu, ketav rachamana "lo yiggael".
Vei ketav rachamana "lo yiggael", vela ketav "od", hava amena: la tifrok kelal, ketav rachamana "od", lichmot shehayta enah nigelet, aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna.
May have ala? amar rava, amar kera: "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel", betzeto miyyad acher.
b: Ibbaya lehu: bealim beyovel sheni, keacher damu o la?
Ta shema: "lo yiggael" — yachol lo tehe nigelet, shettehe lefanav kisde mikna? talmud lomar "od" — lichmot shehayta enah nigelet, aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna.
Emat? illema beyovel rishon — ammay enah nigelet? achuzza name havya! ella peshita beyovel sheni.
Uleman? i lerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon — lechohanim nafka! ella lav lerabbi eliezer, ushema minna: bealim beyovel sheni keacher damu.

Vetisbera?! rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hay "od" may darshi beh? ella, hacha bemay askinan? besade sheyyatza lakkohanim, vehikdishah kohen, vaato bealim lemifreka. salka datach amena: la tifrok, shettehe kisde mikna. talmud lomar: "od" — lichmot shehayta enah nigelet, aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna.
Vehatanya: "yashuv hassade laasher kanahu meitto", yachol yachzor laggizbar shellekachah hemennu? talmud lomar: "laasher lo achuzzat haaretz".
Ma talmud lomar "laasher kanahu"? sade sheyyatza lakkohanim, umecharah kohen, vehikdishah lokeach, ugealah acher — yachol tachzor labbealim harishonim? talmud lomar "laasher kanahu".
Veitzterich lemichtav "lo yiggael", veitzterich lemichtav "laasher kanahu", dei ketav rachamana "lo yiggael" dela ka hadra kelal, ketav rachamana "laasher kanahu".
Vei ketav rachamana "laasher kanahu", dela kayahavi bealim deme, aval hacha, deyahavi bealim deme, detekum bidayhu, ketav rachamana "lo yiggael".
Vei ketav rachamana "lo yiggael", vela ketav "od", hava amena la tifrok kelal, ketav rachamana "od", lichmot shehayta enah nigelet, aval nigelet shettehe lefanav kisde mikna.
May have ala? ta shema: rabbi eliezer omer: gealah bealim beyovel sheni — yotza lakkohanim bayyovel.
