Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: haanan la tenan hachi, rabbi eliezer omer: en hakkohanim nichnasin letochah ad sheyyigalenna acher! amar leh: bealim beyovel sheni keacher damu.

Ikka deamri: rabbi eliezer omer: gealah beyovel sheni — enah yotza lakkohanim bayyovel. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: af anan name tenena, rabbi eliezer omer: en hakkohanim nichnasin letochah ad sheyyigalenna acher! amar leh: i mimmatnitin hava amena: bealim beyovel sheni keacher damu, ka mashma lan.
Mishna hallokeach sade meaviv, umet aviv, veachar kach hikdishah — hare hi kisde achuzza. hikdishah veachar kach met aviv — hare hi kesade mikna, divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim: hare hi kisde achuzza, shenneemar: "im missede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato", sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yatzta zo shehi reuya lihyot sede achuzza.
Sede mikna enah yotza lakkohanim bayyovel, sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello. hakkohanim vehaleviyyim makdishin leolam, vegoalin leolam, ben lifne hayyovel ben leachar hayyovel.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin lelokeach sade meaviv vehikdishah veachar kach met aviv, minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza? talmud lomar: "veim missede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" — sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yatzta zo, sheruya lihyot sede achuzza, divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon.

Rabbi meir omer: minnayin lelokeach sade meaviv, umet aviv veachar kach hikdishah, minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza? talmud lomar: "veim missede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" — sade sheenah sede achuzza, yatzat zo shehi sede achuzza.
Lema beha ka mippalgi, derabbi meir savar: kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame.
Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon savri: kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: bealma lerabbi shimon verabbi yehuda kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame,

a: Vehacha kera ashkuach uderushoy: lichtov rachamana "im missede miknato asher lo sede achuzzato", i name: "asher lo sede achuzza", may "missede achuzzato"? sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yatzta zo sheruya lihyot sede achuzza.

Hakkohanim vehaleviyyim makdishin leolam vechulei. bishlama goalin itzterich, leappoke middeyisrael dela parki ella ad yovel, ka mashma lan dechohanim uleviyyim goalin leolam. ella makdishin, may irya kohanim uleviyyim? afillu yisrael name!

Vechi tema bishnat hayyovel atzmah, hanicha lishmuel deamar: "bishnat hayyovel atzmah la kadsha", ka mashma lan dechohanim uleviyyim makdishin leolam, ella lerav, may irya kohanim uleviyyim? afillu yisrael name!
Uletamaych, ben lifne hayyovel ben leachar hayyovel lema li? ella, ayyeyde ditna resha "lifne hayyovel uleachar hayyovel", tena sefa name "ben leachar hayyovel ben lifne hayyovel".
Veayyeyde ditna resha "en makdishin velo goalin", tena name sefa "makdishin vegoalin".
Hadaran alach en makdishin.
Mishna hammakdish et sadehu beshaa sheen hayyovel, omer lo: "petach atta rishon", shehabbealim notnin chomesh, vechol adam en notnin chomesh.

Maase beechad shehikdish sadehu mippene raatah, amru lo: petach atta rishon. amar: hare hi shelli beissar. amar rabbi yose: lo amar ze "beissar", ella "bevetza", shehekdesh nifde bechesef uveshave kesef, amar lo: "higgaticha", nimtza mafsid issar vesadehu lefanav.
Gemara hammakdish sadehu beshaa kulei. omrin? vehatanya kofin! may "omrin" name? kofin. veibbaet ema: meikkara omrin, i tzaet — tzaet, vei la — kofin.
Shehabbealim notnin chomesh vechulei. may irya shehabbealim notnin chomesh? tippok leh deayyeyde dachaviva aleh tafe ufarek la! veod, mitzvat geulla baadon!
Chada veod kaamar, chada: deayyeyde dachaviva aleh tafe ufarek la, veod: mitzvat geulla baadon hi, veod: shehabbealim notnin chomesh kulei.
Maase beechad shehikdish sadehu vechulei. lema beha kamippalgi, derabbi yose savar: shave kesef kechesef, verabbanan savri: shave kesef eno kechesef.

Veha kayyma lan, deshave kesef kechesef! dechulle alma shave kesef kechesef, vehacha befodin bedavar sheen bechumesho shave peruta kamippalgi. tanna kamma savar: issar, deikka bechumesho shave peruta — parkinan, verabbi yose: kevetza name parkinan.
Amar lo: "higgaticha", nimtza mafsid issar vesadehu lefanav. setama kerabbanan.

Mishna amar echad: "hare hi shelli beeser selaim", veechad omer: "beesrim", veechad omer: "bishloshim", veechad omer: "bearbaim", veechad omer: "bachamishshim". chazar bo shel chamishshim — memashkenin minnechasav ad eser. chazar bo shel arbaim — memashkenin minnechasav ad eser.
Chazar bo shel sheloshim — memashkenin minnechasav ad eser, chazar bo shel esrim — memashkenin minnechasav ad eser, chazar bo shel eser — mochrin oto beshovvyo, venifrain mishshel eser et hammotar.
Habbealim omrim beesrim, vechol adam omrim beesrim — habbealim kodmin, mippene shehem mosifin chomesh. amar echad: "hare hi shelli beesrim veachat" —
b: Habbealim notnin esrim vashesh, "beesrim ushetayim" — habbealim notnin esrim vasheva,
"Beesrim veshalosh" — habbealim notnin esrim ushemone, "beesrim vearba" — habbealim notnin esrim vatesha, "beesrim vechamesh" — habbealim notnin sheloshim, sheen mosifin chomesh al illuyo shel ze.
Amar echad: "hare shelli beesrim vashesh", im ratzu habbealim litten sheloshim veechad vedinar — habbealim kodmin, veim lav — omer lo: "higgaticha".
Gemara amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella shebben arbaim omed bimkomo.
Aval en ben arbaim omed bimkomo, meshalleshin benehen.
Tenan: chazar bo shel arbaim — memashkenin ad eser. ammay? litten bar chamshin bahadeh! delekka ben chamishshim.

Chazar bo ben sheloshim — memashkenin minnechasav ad eser, ammay? velitten deven arbaim bahadeh! delekka ben arbaim. chazar bo ben esrim — memashkenin minnechasav ad eser, ammay? litten deven sheloshim bahadeh! delekka ben sheloshim.

I hachi, ema sefa: chazar bo shel eser, mochrin otah beshovyah venifrain mishshel eser et hammotar, littev deven esrim bahadeh! vechi tema hacha name delekka ben esrim, i hachi, "nifrain mishshel asara" — "nifrain mimmennu" mibbee leh!

Ella amar rav chisda: la kashya, kan bevat achat, kan beze achar ze. tanya name hachi: chazru kullan keechad — meshalleshin benehem. veha anan tenan: memashkenin minnechasav ad eser! ella lav shema minna kidrav chisda, shema minna.

Ikka derame lehu mirma: tenan: chazar bo shel eser, mochrin otah beshovyah venifrain mishshel eser et hammotar, vehatanya: meshalleshin benehem! amar rav chisda: la kashya, kan — bevat achat, kan — beze achar ze.

Habbealim omrim beesrim vechol adam beesrim vechulei. lememra dechomesh adif? ureminhu: baal habbayit omer besela, veechad omer besela veissar — shel sela veissar kodem, mippene shemmosif al hakkeren!
Hacha dechumesha ravvcha dehekdesh hu — chomesh adif, hatam dechumesha ravvcha devaal habbayit — karna tifrok shappir, chumesha la ichpat lan.
Amar echad: hare hu shelli kulei. beesrim vechamesh notnin sheloshim. velemru habbealim: ata gavra bacharikin! daamur bealim dinar.
Velitne dinar! la dak. vela? veha katane: im ratzu habbealim litten sheloshim veechad vedinar — bealim kodmin! ella amar rava: daamur bealim peruta, vela dak.
Sheen mosifin chomesh al illuyo kulei. amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella shello nishshom hekdesh bishlosha, aval nishshom hekdesh bishlosha — mosifin.
Tanya name hachi: bet shammay omrim: mosifin, uvet hillel omrim: en mosifin. hechi dame? i la nishshom, may tama devet shammay? ella denishshom.
Lema rav chisda deamar kevet shammay? leolam dela nishshom, uvet shammay machmirin.
I baet ema: leolam denishshom, veefoch — bet shammay omrim: en mosif. velitneya gabbe kulle bet shammay vechumere bet hillel! ella leolam delo nishshom, uvet shammay machmirin.
Amar echad: hare hi shelli beesrim vashesh kulei. ratzu — in, lo ratzu — la.
Amri: ata gavra bacharikin.
Vedinar may avidteh? amar rav sheshet: hachi kaamar, im ratzu bealim meikkara litten cheshbon hammaggia leechad usheloshim vedinar;

a: Hechi dame? daamur beesrim veechad — habbealim kodmin, veim lav — omer lo: higgaticha.

Mishna macharim adam mitztzono umibbekaro, umeavadav umishshifchotav hakkenaanim, umissede achuzzato, veim hechrim et kullam enam mucheramim, divre rabbi eliezer. amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: ma im laggavoah en adam rashshay lehacherim kol nechasav, al achat kamma vechamma sheyyehe adam chas al nechasav!
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "mikkol asher lo" — velo kol asher lo, "meadam" — velo kol adam, "mibbehema" — velo kol behema, "missede achuzza" — velo kol sede achuzza.

Yachol lo yachrim, veim hechrim yehu mucheramin? talmud lomar: "ach", divre rabbi eliezer. amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: ma im laggavoah en adam rashshay lehacherim kol nechasav, al achat kamma vechamma sheyyehe adam chas al nechasav!
Utzericha, dei ketav rachamana "mikkol asher lo", hava amena: kol deit leh la lachrem, aval min echad laychremeh kulleh, ketav rachamana "meadam" — velo kol adam.

Vei ketav rachamana "meadam", dela saggi leh bela avoda, aval sade — saggi leh bedisturan. vei ashmeinan hane tarte, mishshum dehacha chiyyuta vehacha chiyyuta, aval metaltelin — laychreminhu kullehu, tzerichi.

"Behema" lema li? lechidtanya: yachol yachrim adam beno uvitto, avdo veshifchato haivriyyim, usede miknato? talmud lomar: "behema", ma behema yesh lo reshut lemochrah, af kol sheyyesh lo reshut lemochrah.
Vahalo bitto ketanna yesh lo reshut lemochrah, yachol yachrimenna? talmud lomar: "behema", ma behema yesh lo reshut lemochrah leolam, af kol sheyyesh lo reshut lemochrah leolam.
Amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: im laggavoah en adam rashshay kulei. hayeynu tanna kamma!
Ikka benayyhu derabbi ila, deamar rabbi ila: beusha hitkinu, hamevazbez al yevazbez yoter mechomesh.
Maase beechad shebbikkesh levazbez yoter mechomesh, velo hinnichu lo chaverav. umannu? rabbi yeshevav, veamri la: rabbi yeshevav, velo hinnichu lo chaverav. umannu? rabbi akiva.

Mishna hammachrim beno uvitto, veavdo veshifchato haivrim, usede miknato — en mucheramin, sheen adam machrim davar sheeno shello. hakkohanim vehaleviyyim en machrimin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: hakkohanim en machrimin — shehacharamin shellahen, vehaleviyyim machrimin — sheen hacharamin shellahen.
Amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda bekarkaot, shenneemar: "ki achuzzat olam hi lahem", vedivre rabbi shimon bemittaltelin, sheen hacharamin shellahen.

Gemara verabbi yehuda, bishlama kohanim en machrimin — shecharamin shellahen, ella leviyyim, bishlama mekarkee la machremi — dichtiv: "ki achuzzat olam hi lahem", ella mittaltele laychremuy! amar kera: "mikkol asher lo... umissede achuzzato" — makkish mittaltelin lekarkaot.

Verabbi shimon, bishlama kohanim — kedaamaran, ella leviyyim, bishlama metaltelim lachrem — dela makkesh, ella mekarkee ammay? hachtiv "achuzzat olam hi lahem"! may "machrimin" name dekaamar? mittaltele.

Veha middekatane sefa: amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda bimkarkee vedivre rabbi shimon bemittaltele, mikkelal derabbi shimon mekarkee name kaamar? hachi kaamar: amar rabbi: nirin divre rabbi yehuda lerabbi shimon bekarkaot, sheaf rabbi shimon lo nechlak ella bemittaltelin, aval bekarkaot mode leh.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin: hechrim metaltelin — notnan lechol kohen sheyyirtze, shenneemar: "kol cherem beyisrael
b: Lecha yihye". hechrim sedotav — notnan lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar, shenneemar: "kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato", vegamar "lakkohen" "lakkohen" miggezel hagger.
Vehatam menalan? detanya: "laAdonai lakkohen" — kenao hashshem unetano lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar.
Atta omer lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar, o eno ella lechol kohen sheyyirtze? keshehu omer: "millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo alav", hare bechohen shebbeoto mishmar hakkatuv medabber.
Sade hayyotza lakkohanim bayyovel, notnah lammishmar sheppaga bo yovel. ibbaya lehu: paga bo beshabbat, may? amar rav chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh dechulepana: notnah lammishmar hayyotze.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tanya, nimtzeta atta omer, echad yovel veechad sheviit meshammetin keechad, ella sheyyovel bitchillato vehashshemitta besofah.
Adderabba, mishshum hachi havay! ema: mippene shehayyovel kulei.

Bishlama sheviit besofah, dichtiv: "mikketz sheva shanim taase shemitta", ella yovel bitchillato? beyom hakkippurim hu, dichtiv: "bayyom hakkippurim taaviru shofar bechol artzechem"! ha manni? rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi, deamar: merosh hashshana hu dechayel yovel.
Shama chizkiyya bar bilvati, vaazal amar kammeh derabbi avahu: velaykkesh mittaltele lekarkaot!
Lav tannae hi? deikka demakkesh, veikka dela makkesh, keman deamar: "la makkeshinan".
Mishna cherme kohanim, en lahem pidyon, ella nivtanim lakkohanim kitruma. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: setam charamim levedek habbayit, shenneemar: "kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai".

Vachachamim omrim: setam charamim lakkohanim, shenneemar: "kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato". im ken, lamma neemar "kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai"? shechal al kodshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim.
Machrim adam et kodashav, ben kodshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim, im neder — noten demehen.
Veim nedava, noten et tovatan. "shor ze ola" — omdin kamma adam rotze litten beshor ze lehaaloto ola, af al pi sheeno rashshay.
Habbechor, ben tam ben baal mum — machrimin oto, vechetzad podim oto? omdin kamma adam rotze litten bivchor ze litteno leven bitto o leven achoto.

a: Gemara tanu rabbanan: cherme chohanim en lahen pidyon venivtanin lakkohen. charamim kol zeman shehen bevet bealim hare hen kehekdesh lechol divrehen, shenneemar: "kol cherem beyisrael kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai". netanan lechohen — hare hen lechol divrehen kechullin, shenneemar: "kol cherem beyisrael lecha yihye".

Rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: setam charamim levedek habbayit kulei. bishlama rabbanan kidka mefarshi tamayyhu vetama derabbi yehuda ben betira, ella rabbi yehuda ben betira hay "kisde hacherem" may aved leh?

Mibbaya leh lechidtanya: "kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato", ma talmud lomar? minnayin lechohen shehikdish sede chermo, shello yomar: hoil veyotza lakkohanim, vahare hi tachat yadi — tehe shelli?
Vedin hu: beshel acherim ani zoche, beshel atzmi lo kol shekken? talmud lomar: "kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato".
Vechi ma lamadnu missede cherem meatta? hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed: makkish sede chermo lisde achuzza shel yisrael.
Ma sede achuzza shel yisrael, yotza mittachat yado, umitchalleket lakkohanim, af sade chermo, yotza mittachat yado, umitchalleket leechav hakkohanim.
Veiddach? mecherem" "hacherem". veiddach, "cherem" "hacherem" la mashma leh.
Verabbi yehuda ben betira, dechal al kodshe kadashim veal kadashim kallim, mena leh? savar leh kerabbi yishmael.
Amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira, verav shavek rabbanan veaved kerabbi yehuda ben betira? barayyta ippecha tanya, shavek matnitin veaved kevarayyta? rav matnitin name ippecha tane.

May chazet deafchat matnitin mikkamme barayyta? nefech barayyta mikkamme matnitin! rav gemareh gemir. i hachi, kerabbi yehuda ben betira? kerabbanan mibbee leh! hachi kaamar: lemay deafchitu vetanetu, halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira.

Hahu gavra deachreminhu lenichseh befumebdita, ata lekammeh derav yehuda, amar leh: shekol arbea zuze veachel alayyhu, ushedinhu benahara, velishtero lach. alma kasavar: setam charamim levedek habbayit.
Keman? kishmuel, deamar: hekdesh shave mane shechillelo al shave peruta mechullal. emar deamar shemuel shechillelo, lechattechilla mi amar?
Hane mille bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, deikka peseda, aval bizman hazze afillu lechattechilla. i hachi, afillu peruta name? parsome milleta.
Amar ulla: i havay hatam, hava yahevna kullehu lechohanim. alma kasavar ulla: setam charamim lakkohanim.
Metivi: en eved ivri noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg, shenneemar: "ad shenat hayyovel yaavod immach".
Veen sede hacherem noheget ella bizman shehayyovel noheg, shenneemar: "veyatza bayyovel veshav laachuzzato". en batte are choma nohagin ella bizman shehayyovel noheg, shenneemar: "lo yetze bayyovel".

Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: en sede charamin nohagin ella bizman shehayyovel noheg, shenneemar: "vehaya hassade betzeto vayyovel kodesh laAdonai kisde hacherem". rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: en ger toshav noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg.
Amar rav bivi: may tama? atya "tov" "tov", ketiv hacha: "ki tov lo immach", uchetiv hatam: "battov lo lo tonennu"!
La kashya: ha bimkarkee, ha bemittaltele. veha maase defumebdita bimkarkee name hava! mekarkee dechutza laaretz kemittaltele deeretz yisrael dame.

Mishna rabbi yishmael omer: katuv echad omer "takdish", vechatuv echad omer "lo yakdish". i efshar lomar "takdish" — shehare kevar neemar "lo yakdish", i efshar lomar "lo yakdish" — shehare kevar neemar "takdish".
Ha ketzad? makdisho atta hekdesh illuy, vei atta makdisho hekdesh mizbeach.
Gemara, verabbanan: "al takdish" mibbee leh lelav, "takdish" mibbee leh lechidtanya: minnayin lenolad bechor beedro shemmitzva lehakedisho? shenneemar: "hazzachar takdish".
Verabbi yishmael, i la makdesh leh, la kadesh? kedushshato merechem hu, vechevan dechi la makdesh leh kadosh, la tzerich leakdosheh.
Hadaran alach hammakdish sadehu.
b: Mishna hammocher et sadehu bishat hayyovel — eno muttar ligol pachot mishte shanim, shenneemar: "bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach".

Hayta shenat shiddafon veyerakon, o shenat sheviit — enav ola min hamminyan. narah o hovirah — ola lo min hamminyan. rabbi eliezer omer: mecharah lo lifne rosh hashshana vehi melea perot — hare ze ochel mimmenna shalosh tevuot bishte shanim.
Gemara hammocher sadehu bishat hayyovel vechulei. "eno goel" la katane, ella "eno muttar ligol", alma kasavar: issura name ikka, daafillu karkoshe zuze name asur.
Vela mibbaya mocher, dekae baase, dichtiv: "bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach", ella afillu lokeach name kae baase, devaenan "shanim tikne", velekka.

Ittemar: hammocher sadehu bishnat hayyovel atzmah, rav amar: mechura veyotza, ushemuel amar: enah mechura kol ikkar. may tama dishmuel? kal vachomer, uma mechura kevar yotza, sheenah mechura eno din shello timmacher?

Ulerav, la amrinan kal vachomer ki hay gavvna? vehatanya: yachol yimkor adam et bitto keshehi naara? amarta kal vachomer: uma mechura kevar — yotza achshav, sheenah mechura — eno din shello timmacher?
Hatam la hadra mizdabbena, hacha hadra mizdabbena.
Metivi: "achar hayyovel shanim tikne" — melammed shemmochrin samuch layyovel, mufelag min hayyovel minnayin? talmud lomar: "lefi rov hashshanim... ulefi meot hashshanim".
Uvishnat hayyovel atzmah lo yimkor, veim machar — enah mechura! amar lecha rav: enah mechura lemispar shene tevuot, aval mechura hi veyotza.

Vei izdabbone mizdabbena, tekum birshuteh ad batar yovel, uvatar yovel nechlay shene tevuot venayhdera! mi la tanya: achalah shana achat lifne hayyovel — mashlimin lo shana acheret achar hayyovel? hatam nachet laachila, hacha la nachet laachila.
Amar rav anan: shemait minneh demar shemuel tarte, chada hach, veiddach hammocher avdo legoyim o bechutza laaretz yatza lecherut.
Chada hadri zevine, vachada la hadri zevine, vela yadana he (minneh) [minnayhu].

Amar rav yosef: nichze anan, middetanya bevarayyta: hammocher avdo bechutza laaretz yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur merabbo sheni. shema minna, middekare leh lesheni "rabbo", alma la hadri zevine, vechi kaamar shemuel hacha: enah mechura umaot chozrin.

a: Verav anan barayyta la shemia leh, vedishmuel mimmay deenah mechura umaot chozrin? dilma enah mechura umaot mattana, midde dehave ammekaddesh achoto, deittemar: hamekaddesh achoto — rav amar: maot chozrin, ushemuel amar: maot mattana.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: may chazet dekansinan leh lelokeach? nikneseh lemocher!
Amar leh: lav achbera gannav, ella chora gannav. i lav achbera, chora mena leh? mistabbera, hecha deiteh leissura kansinan.
Hayta shenat shiddafon kulei. hasheta hovirah ola lo, narah mibbaya?
Narah itzterich leh — salka datach amena, amrinan leh: hav leh demeh velissak, ka mashma lan.

Rabbi eliezer omer: mecharah lo kulei. tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: minnayin sheim mecharah lo lifne rosh hashshana melea perot, shello yomar lo: "hannach lefanay kederech shehinnachti lefanecha"? talmud lomar: "bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach", peamim sheadam ochel shalosh tevuot bishte shanim.
Mishna mecharah larishon bemane, umachar rishon lashsheni bematayim, eno mechashshev ella im harishon, shenneemar: "asher machar lo".

Mecharah larishon bematayim, umachar harishon lashsheni bemane — eno mechashshev ella im haacharon, shenneemar: "vechishshav et shene mimkaro veheshiv et haodef laish asher machar lo", laish asher betocho.
Lo yimkor berachok veyigal bekarov, beraa veyigal beyafa, velo yilve veyigal, velo yigal lachatzain, uvahekdesh muttar bechullan. ze chomer bahedyot mibbahekdesh.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: mecharah larishon bemane, umecharah rishon lashsheni bematayim, minnayin sheeno mechashshev ella im harishon? talmud lomar: "[laish] asher machar lo".
Mecharah larishon bematayim, umachar harishon lashsheni bemane, minnayin sheen mechashshevin ella im hashsheni? talmud lomar: "laish [laish] asher betocho", divre rabbi.
Rabbi dostay ben yehuda omer: mecharah lo bemane, vehishbichah veamda al matayim, minnayin sheeno mechashshev ella bemane? shenneemar: "veheshiv et haodef" — haodef shebbeyado.
Mecharah lo bematayim, vehichsifa veamda al mane, minnayin sheen mechashshevin ella bemane? shenneemar: "veheshiv et haodef" — haodef shebbakkarka.
May benayyhu? deiyyaykkar, vezal, veiyyaykkar.
Umimmay dilkulla? dilma lechumera!
La salka datach, degamar "geulla" "geulla" meeved ivri.
Vehatam menalan? detanya: nimkar bemane, vehishbiach veamad al matayim, minnayin sheen mechashshevin ella mimmane? shenneemar: "mikkesef miknato".
Nimkar bematayim, vehichsif veamad al mane, minnayin sheen mechashshevin ella mimmane? shenneemar: "kefi shanav".
Veen li ella eved ivri hannimkar legoy, shennigal veyado al haelyona, nimkar leyisrael minnayin? talmud lomar: "sachir" "sachir" ligzera shava.
Amar abbaye:
b: Hareni keven azzay beshuke teverya. amar leh hahu merabbanan leabbaye: ikka lemidreshinhu lekulla, veikka lemidreshinhu lechumera, mimmay dilkulla? ema lechumera!

La salka dataych, middeakkel rachamana gabbeh, detanya: "ki tov lo immach" — immach bammaachol, immecha bammishte, shello tehe ochel pat nekiyya vehu ochel pat kibbar, atta shote yayin yashan vehu shote yayin chadash, atta yashen al gabbe mochin vehu yashen al gabbe karka; mikkan amru: hakkone eved ivri kekone adon leatzmo.
Adderabba, nachmir aleh midderabbi yose berabbi chanina! deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: "bo uree kamma kashe avakah shel sheviit".

Adam nose venoten beferot sheviit, lesof mocher et mittaltelav, shenneemar: "bishnat hayyovel hazzot tashuvu ish el achuzzato", uchetiv: "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha", davar hannikne miyyad leyad.
Lo hirgish — lassof mocher et sedotav, shenneemar: "vechi yamuch achicha umachar meachuzzato".

Lo bat leyado — lassof mocher et beto, shenneemar: "veish ki yimkor bet moshav ir choma". may shena hatam dekaamar "lo hirgish", umay shena hacha dekaamar "lo bat leyado"? kidrav huna, deamar rav huna: kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah, huttera lo.
Huttera lo salka datach?! ella ema: naaset lo kehetter.
Lo bat leyado — lassof shellove beribbit, shenneemar: "vechi yamuch achicha vegomer", uchetiv: "al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit".

Lo bat leyado — ad shemmocher et bitto, shenneemar: "vechi yimkor ish [et] bitto leama", veaf al gav devitto behay inyana leta, nicha leinish delizabben beratte vela lezif beribbita, deillu hatam meygara veazla, veillu hacha ka mosfa veazla.

Lo bat leyado — lassof shemmocher et atzmo, shenneemar: "ki yamuch achicha immach venimkar lach"; lo lach ella leger, shenneemar: "leger", velo leger tzedek ella leger toshav, shenneemar: "leger toshav".
"Mishpachat ger" — ze haggoy. keshehu omer "o leeker mishpachat ger" — ze hannimkar venaase mesharet laavoda zara atzmah.

Amar leh: ha ahdereh kera, vetana deve rabbi yishmael: hoil vehalach umachar atzmo laavoda zara, edche even acher hannofel? talmud lomar: "geullat olam tihye lo uvayyovel yetze". ema: geulla tihye lo — dela littamma baggoyim, uleolam leinyan pidyono nachmir!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ketiv "im od rabbot bashshanim", uchetiv "im meat nishar bashshanim".
Vechi yesh shanim merubbot veyesh shanim muatot? ella: nitrabba kaspo — "mikkesef miknato", nitmaet kaspo — "kefi shanav".
Veema: hecha daavad tarte ufayyshi arbee — littev leh arba "mikkesef miknato", vehecha daavad arba ufayyshi tarte — littev leh tarte "kefi shanav"!

Im ken, nichtov "im od rabbot shanim", may "bashshanim"? nitrabba kaspo bashshanim — mikkesef miknato", nitmaet kaspo bashshanim — "kefi shanav". amar rav yosef: darshinhu rav nachman lehane kerae kesinay.
Lo yimkor berachok kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vehissiga yado" — yad atzmo, shello yilve veyigal.
"Umatza" — perat lematzuy, shello yimkor berachok veyigol bekarov, bera veyigol beyafe; "kede geullato" — kede geulla hu goel, veeno goel lachatzain.

Lememra dematza" hasheta mashma? ureminhu: "umatza" — perat lemamtzi atzmo, mikkan amar rabbi eliezer: im mishsheyyatza even mittachat yado, hotzi halla et rosho vekibbelah — patur; alma "matza" mide deiteh meikkara mashma!

Amar rava: hacha meinyana dikra, vehacha meinyana dikra. hacha dumeya dehissiga yado", ma "hissiga yado" dehashta, af "matza" name dehashta. vehacha dumeya deyaar", ma yaar milleta deiteh meikkara, af "matza" milleta deiteh meikkara.
Uvehekdesh kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "veim gaol yigal" — melammed shellove vegoel, vegoel lachatzain.
Amar rabbi shimon: ma taam? lefi shemmatzinu bemocher sede achuzza sheyyippa kocho, sheim higgia yovel velo nigala chozeret labbealim bayyovel — hora kocho, sheeno love vegoel, veeno goel lachatzain.
Aval makdish sede achuzza, hoil shehora kocho, sheim higgia yovel velo nigala yotza lakkohanim, yippa kocho shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain.

a: Tane chada: love vegoel vegoel lachatzain, vetanya iddach: eno love vegoel veeno goel lachatzain. la kashya, ha rabbanan veha rabbi shimon.
Mishna hammocher bet bevatte are choma — hare ze goel miyyad, vegoel kol shenem asar chodesh, hare ze kemin ribbit, veeno ribbit.
Met hammocher — yigal beno, met hallokeach — yigal miyyad beno. en monin shana ella mishshaa shemmachar, shenneemar: "ad melot lo shana".

Keshehu omer "temima", lehavi et chodesh haibbur. rabbi omer: litten lo shana veibburah. higgia yom shenem asar chodesh velo nigala — hayta chaluta lo. echad hallokeach veechad hannittan lo bemattana, shenneemar: "latztzemitut".
Gemara matnitin dela kerabbi, detanya: rabbi omer: "yamim" — en yamim pachot mishshenayim.
Verabbanan, hay "yamim" may avdi leh? mibbee leh miyyom leyom. verabbi, miyyom leyom mena leh? nafka leh mead tom shenat mimkaro".

Verabbanan? hahu mibbee leh shenat mimkaro shello, velo (shenat) [shana] shel minyan olam. veyamim mibbee lehu lemeet leet, dei mead tom shenat mimkaro" hava amena: miyyom leyom — in, meet leet — la, ketav rachamana "yamim".
Verabbi, meet leet mena leh? nafka leh mittemima". verabbanan? hahu mibbee leh leibbura.
Verabbi name, ha mibbee leh leibbura! hachi name, miyyom leyom umeet leet mead tom shenat mimkaro" nafka.
Hare zo kemin ribbit vechulei. vehatanya: hare zo ribbit gemura, ella shehattora hittirattu!

Amar rabbi yochanan: la kashya, ha rabbi yehuda veha rabbanan. detanya: hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane, veasa lo sadehu mecher, bizman shehammocher ochel perot — muttar, lokeach ochel perot — asur.

Rabbi yehuda omer: af bizman shehallokeach ochel perot — muttar. amar rabbi yehuda: maase bevaytos ben zonin sheasa sadehu mecher al pi rabbi elazar ben azarya, velokeach ochel perot haya. amru lo: mishsham reayay? mocher ochel perot haya, velo lokeach.
May benayyhu? tzad echad beribbit ikka benayyhu, tanna kamma savar: tzad echad beribbit asur, verabbi yehuda savar: tzad echad beribbit muttar.
b: Rava amar: dechulle alma tzad echad beribbit asur, vehacha beribbit al menat lehachezir ikka benayyhu — mar savar: asur, umar savar: muttar.
Met hammocher yigal beno. peshita! mahu detema: "veish ki yimkor bet moshav" amar rachamana, vehay lav mechar, kamashma lan: "vehayta geullato" — mikkol makom.
Met hallokeach yigal miyyad beno vechulei. peshita! mahu detema: "lakkone oto" amar rachamana, veha la kena — ka mashma lan: "vehayta geullato" mikkol makom.
En monin lo shana ella mishshaa shemmachar kulei. tanu rabbanan: shana — eni yodea im shana larishon im shana lashsheni, keshehu omer "ad melot lo shana temima" — heve shana larishon.

Lemi chalut? rabbi elazar omer: larishon chalut, rabbi yochanan amar: lashsheni chalut. bishlama lerabbi elazar dildideh ka manenan, ella lerabbi yochanan may tama? amar rabbi abba bar memel: ma machar lo rishon lesheni — kol zechut shettavo leyado.

Amar rabbi abba bar memel: machar shene batte are choma, echad bachamishsha asar baadar harishon veechad beechad baadar hashsheni; ze shemmachar lo baadar hashsheni, kevan shehiggia yom echad baadar shel shana habbaa — alta lo shana; ze shemmachar lo bachamishsha asar shel adar harishon — lo alta lo shana ad chamishsha asar baadar shel shana habbaa.
Matkef la ravina, velema leh: "ana kadem shachen nura mikkamme didach"! mishshum daamar leh: "at nechet leibbura".

Veamar rabbi abba bar memel: noldu lo shene telaim, echad bachamishsha asar shel adar harishon veechad beechad baadar hashsheni, ze shennolad baadar hashsheni, kevan shehiggia yom echad baadar shel shana habbaa — alta lo shana, ze shennolad lo bachamishsha asar baadar harishon — lo alta lo shana ad chamishsha asar baadar shel shana habbaa.
Matkef la ravina, velema leh: ana kadem achel yerukka mikkammach didach! mishshum daamar leh: at nechett leibbura, ana la nechetna leibbura.
Ha tu lema li? hayeynu hach! mahu detema: hatam, dichtiv "temima", hacha, dela ketiv "temima" — la. ka mashma lan, deshana" "shana" mehadade gamri.

Keshehu omer "temima" kulei. rabbi omer: litten shenat ibburah. tanu rabbanan: "shana temima", rabbi omer: mone shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha yamim keminyan yemot hachamma, vachachamim omrim: mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leyom, veim nitabbera — nitabbera lo.
Higgia yom shenem asar chodesh velo nigal kulei. tanu rabbanan: "latztzemitut" — lachalutin. davar acher: "latztzemitut" — lerabbot et hammattana. may tama? "tzemit" "tzemitut".
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa, keman? dela kerabbi meir, dei kerabbi meir — haamar mattana enah kemecher! amar rav pappa: afillu tema rabbi meir, shane hacha derabbi rachamana "latztzemitut".

Amaru rabbanan lerav pappa, vaamar la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: veha gabbe yovel, dichtiv "tashuvu" lerabbot et hammattana, verabbi meir la ka merabbe! ella ha vadday dela kerabbi meir.
Tanu rabbanan: hammakdish bayit bevatte are choma — hare ze goel, vegoel leolam. gealo acher miyyad hekdesh, higgia yom shenem asar chodesh velo nigal — haya chalut lo.
Mena hane mille? amar shemuel, deamar kera: "lakkone oto", vaafillu miyyad hekdesh. velachleteh hekdesh? amar kera: "ledorotav", yatza hekdesh sheen lo dorot.
Lo yetze bayyovel, lema li? amar rav safra: lo nitzrecha ella lemocher bayit bevatte are choma, ufaga bo yovel betoch shenato. salka datach amena: lippok beyovel, ka mashma lan: "lo yetze bayyovel".

Mishna barishona haya nitman yom shenem asar chodesh, kede sheyyehe chalut lo. hitkin hillel sheyyehe cholesh meotav lallishka, vihe shover et haddelet venichnas, ematay sheyyirtze hallaz yavo veyittol et meotav.
Gemara amar rava: mittakkanato shel hallel — "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", unetanah lo middato — megoreshet, beal korcho — enah megoreshet.
